notes.title: V5.35 Event Announcements
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Authorizers!

New limited-time events will begin after the server update. Please read the following event rules or view the in-game event and rewards panel for details.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Helene Limited Order◢[/p][p]Event Period: September 23 (After update) - October 27, 21:00(UTC+0)[/p][p]During the event, Authorizers can use Red Nuclei to place orders in the Helene Special Order event. The chance of obtaining the exclusive weapon "Pollux" will be significantly increased, and acquiring it for the first time will unlock the limited Helene Simulacrum. Each order grants a random weapon plus 1 extra Flame Gold. Every 120 Flame Gold can be exchanged for the current chance-up weapon - "Pollux".[/p][p]During the event, Authorizers can use Special Vouchers to place orders in the Helene Special Order event. The chance of obtaining the exclusive Helene Matrix will be significantly increased, and acquiring it for the first time will grant an additional Overclocking Chip. Every 80 Overclocking Chips can be exchanged for the current chance-up item - "Helene Matrix".[/p][p][/p][p]Free Pick Special Order Reissue[/p][p]◤Lyncis, Gray Fox, Meryl Ironheart, Roslyn & Yanuo Free Pick Reissue◢[/p][p]Event Period: September 23 (After update) - October 27, 21:00(UTC+0)[/p][p]During the event, Authorizers can use Red Nuclei and Special Vouchers to participate in the Free Pick Special Order event. There are 5 limited weapon pools and 5 limited Matrix pools, each offering a higher chance to acquire the corresponding Limited Weapons and Limited Matrices.[/p][p]In this event, drawing Weapons or Matrices will grant Flame Gold and Overclocking Chips. Authorizers can exchange 120 Flame Gold or 80 Overclocking Chips for any of the chance-up weapons or designated Matrix parts in the Card Pool Store.[/p][p]※After the event ends, any remaining Flame Gold and Overclocking Chips will be converted into Black Gold and Base Chips.[/p][p]※After the event ends, the weapon Wicked will be added to the Choice Weapons special order event, and the Yanuo Matrix will be added to the Choice Matrices special order event.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Galactic Bounty◢[/p][p]Event Period: September 23 (After update) - October 27, 21:00(UTC+0)[/p][p]Event Info: Galactic Bounty brings a mix of fun and challenges. Join in to earn event tokens and exchange them for items and exclusive cosmetics.[/p][p]◤Twisted Crisis◢[/p][p]Event Period: September 23 (After update) - October 27, 21:00(UTC+0)[/p][p]Event Info: Crisis Drill Simulation – Squad members are infected by Aberrants. notes.title: Ver.5.35 "Twin Fates" Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Authorizers,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a maintenance update to bring you a better gaming experience. After the update, version 5.35 "Twin Fates" will be released.[/p][p][/p][p]After the update, servers The Morning Star and Takoyaki, as well as Rainbow Road and Nirvana, will be merged. Please check the official announcement for more details.[/p][p]The Limited-Time Plotti Reissue event will end after the update. The weapon EP-7000 Skyfire will be added to the Choice Weapons special order event, and the Plotti Matrix will be added to the Choice Matrices special order event.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Update Time◢[/p][p]September 23, 04:00 - 08:00(UTC+0)[/p][p](Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)[/p][p][/p][p]◤How to Update◢[/p][p]Resource Update: Once the server goes offline, you can update the game in advance and play the new version as soon as it reopens. We recommend using Wi-Fi for updates on mobile devices.[/p][p]How to Update[/p][p]PC & PlayStation:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, manually exit the client and restart it to begin the update.[/p][p]2. Once the resource update starts downloading, you can minimize the window, and it will continue in the background.[/p][p]Note: The PC & PlayStation login system has been upgraded. If you experience a login error after updating, restart the client and log out before logging back in. If the issue persists, contact customer support.[/p][p]Android & iOS:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, download the new version from your app store.[/p][p]2. Launch the game to start the resource update, which will continue in the background.[/p][p]Server Shutdown Notice: We recommend exiting the game at least 15 minutes before the update. To prevent issues, avoid making purchases within 5 minutes before the server shuts down, as this may affect gameplay or cause account asset loss.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Compensation◢[/p][p]Dark Crystal * 400[/p][p]Compensation eligibility: players who have reached level 6 before the update.[/p][p]We will send the above compensation to your mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. The mail will be valid for 7 days, so please be sure to claim it in time.[/p][p][/p][p]◤New Content/Fixes◢[/p][p]1. New Simulacrum: Helene[/p][p]For me and my bro, our cosmic adventure will never end![/p][p]2. Added Simulacrum Side Mission: A Fleeting Thought[/p][p]Fate is sealed—do you believe in time travel? Is it a dream, or a painful memory? The eccentric yet popular captain of the Black Moon Gang takes the stage. Forgotten memories, untold pasts, and unexpected encounters now return to the traveler out of place. A mysterious journey begins, and so does a bittersweet time adventure...[/p][p]3. Added Helene Simulacrum Dorm.[/p][p]4. Opened Lechesis Simulacrum Dorm Scenario Mode. Optimized Stitch Doll action and toe model effects.[/p][p]5. Added Battle Pass Vehicle to the Store.[/p][p]6. A new season of Evolution Frontier is about to begin, introducing new enemies and mechanics.[/p][p]7. New season of Sequential Phantasm available.[/p][p]8. New season of Void Abyss available.[/p][p]9. New Evolution Vanguard Mode: Level 100 Boss - Nan Yin.[/p][p]10. Added Stage 30 - Culton to the Boundless Realm.[/p][p]11. Added new levels to Bygone Phantasm: Boundless Realm.[/p][p]12. Added a Helene Simulacrum instance to Multiverse Hunt and the Leaderboard.[/p][p]13. Optimized reward effect display in Crew Base Simulacrum On Duty.[/p][p]14. Fixed an issue on iOS devices where Ruin D-01 stages could occasionally behave abnormally.[/p][p]15. Fixed an issue in undersea mode where Eternal Salvation's skill could not inflict Armor Dissolve to nearby targets.[/p][p]16. Reduced HP and other stats of some enemies in Network and Kailo regions.[/p][p]17. Fixed some issues previously reported.[/p][p]18. Optimized localization for certain texts.[/p][p]19. Adjusted and optimized other in-game features.[/p]

notes.title: Ver.5.2 "Dream of Homecoming" Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Authorizers,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a maintenance update to bring you a better gaming experience. After the update, version 5.2 "Dream of Homecoming" will be released.[/p][p][/p][p]After the version update, all tiers in the Purchase Rewards interface will reset to the Double First Purchase Bonus state. Each tier will receive double Dark Crystal rebates on the first purchase after the reset. However, tiers that had no first purchase before the reset will not retain their double rebate counts, meaning they will not trigger the bonus twice.[/p][p]Meanwhile, the purchase limits for Rookie Supplies and Adventure Packs in the store will be reset.[/p][p]In addition, after this update, the amount of Tanium received from each tier on the Purchase Rewards interface will be adjusted. The details are as follows:[/p][p]300 Tanium: Increased to 310 Tanium, with the bonus of 20 Dark Crystals increased to 30 Dark Crystals[/p][p]980 Tanium: Increased to 1,020 Tanium, with the bonus of 110 Dark Crystals increased to 140 Dark Crystals[/p][p]1,980 Tanium: Increased to 2,080 Tanium, with the bonus of 270 Dark Crystals increased to 350 Dark Crystals[/p][p]3,280 Tanium: Increased to 3,480 Tanium, with the bonus of 530 Dark Crystals increased to 700 Dark Crystals[/p][p]6,480 Tanium: Increased to 6,980 Tanium, with the bonus of 1,300 Dark Crystals increased to 1,600 Dark Crystals[/p][p]The "Yan Miao: Limited-Time Reissue" event will end after the update. Once the update is complete, the weapon "Equilibrium" will be added to the permanent \[Choice Weapons] special order, and "Yan Miao: Matrix" will be added to the permanent \[Choice Matrices] special order.[/p][p]Fiona Synesthesia Materials will become available and refresh every week in the Crystal Dust Store after the update.[/p][p]Please note that Fiona Synesthesia is only available for global server and PlayStation users.[/p][p]After the V5.2 update, account data will be interoperable across PlayStation, mobile platforms (iOS/Android), and PC. For more details, please refer to the “PlayStation Account Linking”announcement.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Update Time◢[/p][p]July 29, 04:00–09:00(UTC+0)[/p][p](Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)[/p][p][/p][p]◤How to Update◢[/p][p]Resource Update: Once the server goes offline, you can update the game in advance and play the new version as soon as it reopens. We recommend using Wi-Fi for updates on mobile devices.[/p][p]How to Update[/p][p]PC:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, manually exit the client and restart it to begin the update.[/p][p]2. Once the resource update starts downloading, you can minimize the window, and it will continue in the background.[/p][p]Note: The PC login system has been upgraded. If you experience a login error after updating, restart the client and log out before logging back in. If the issue persists, contact customer support."[/p][p]Android & iOS:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, download the new version from your app store.[/p][p]2. Launch the game to start the resource update, which will continue in the background."[/p][p]Server Shutdown Notice: We recommend exiting the game at least 15 minutes before the update. To prevent issues, avoid making purchases within 5 minutes before the server shuts down, as this may affect gameplay or cause account asset loss.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Compensation◢[/p][p]Dark Crystal * 500[/p][p]Compensation eligibility: players who have reached level 6 before the update.[/p][p]We will send the above compensation to your mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. The mail will be valid for 7 days, so please be sure to claim it in time.[/p][p][/p][p]◤New Content◢[/p][p]1. New Simulacrum: Hipper[/p][p]Here, once, we lost our way—hoping the void would claim us, to be forgotten in the spacetime turbulence... But years later, the Homecomer Assembly calls once more. Captain Hipper raises her favorite Vespertini and downs it in one go—Follow her into the forbidden zones where no ship dares drift. Hold your breath and witness a battle like you've never seen before![/p][p]2. New Main Story - Lost Universe: Long Way Home[/p][p]After years of silence, the Homecomer Assembly is held once more. But its former host, Granny Lola, has just been slain by the Hope Fleet. Amid rising tensions, Violet Crew Captain Laurent announces he will lead her funeral. Hope Fleet officer Hipper, once Lola's student, chooses to attend. Now with pirates and the fleet on the brink of war, can Hipper make it out alive? And where will revenge lead Kailo next?[/p][p]3. A new map, Kailo - Wood Belt, has been added, featuring 4 new gameplay modes: Tusk Bullring, Random Graffiti, Wasteland, and Lucky 999.[/p][p]4. Added a new World Boss: Calamity No. 5.[/p][p]5. Added Hipper's Simulacrum Dorm.[/p][p]6. Added Fiona Synesthesia.[/p][p]7. New season of Evolution Frontier available.[/p][p]8. New season of Sequential Phantasm available.[/p][p]9. New season of Void Abyss available.[/p][p]10. Phase 26 Pass Outfit - Voidrider Captain now available in the Store (1,280 Tanium).[/p][p]11. Added the Vehicle: Light of Homecomer.[/p][p]12. Added a limited-time Raid instance - Swarm Guard.[/p][p]13. Evolution Vanguard mode: Level 100 Boss - Jormungand is now available.[/p][p]14. Added Stage 28 - Defender to the Boundless Realm.[/p][p]15. Added new levels to Bygone Phantasm: Boundless Realm.[/p][p]16. Added a Hipper Simulacrum instance to Multiverse Hunt and the Leaderboard.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Version Optimization and Bug Fixes◢[/p][p]1. Modification to Requiem's active skill, Extreme Attack Switch - Thunderclap: The duration of Alpha Attack has been extended from 20s to 25s.[/p][p]2. Raid challenge time adjusted: Heroic difficulty is now 900 seconds, Challenging difficulty is now 600 seconds.[/p][p]3. Raid past season rankings adjusted: Top 100 players displayed instead of the top 50.[/p][p]4. Optimized the Backpack interface display.[/p][p]5. Resolved an issue on mobile where using a controller would prevent mechas from correctly activating skills and switching targets.[/p][p]6. Adjusted/optimized some other in-game features.[/p][p]7. Fixed other issues previously reported.[/p]

notes.title: Ver.5.1 "Scarlet Starfire" Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Authorizers,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a maintenance update to bring you a better gaming experience. After the update, version 5.1 "Scarlet Starfire" will be released.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Update Time◢[/p][p]June 24, 06:00–10:00(UTC+0)[/p][p](Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)[/p][p][/p][p]◤How to Update◢[/p][p]Resource Update: Once the server goes offline, you can update the game in advance and play the new version as soon as it reopens. We recommend using Wi-Fi for updates on mobile devices.[/p][p]How to Update[/p][p]PC:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, manually exit the client and restart it to begin the update.[/p][p]2. Once the resource update starts downloading, you can minimize the window, and it will continue in the background.[/p][p]Note: The PC login system has been upgraded. If you experience a login error after updating, restart the client and log out before logging back in. If the issue persists, contact customer support."[/p][p]Android & iOS:[/p][p]1. After the server shuts down, download the new version from your app store.[/p][p]2. Launch the game to start the resource update, which will continue in the background."[/p][p]Server Shutdown Notice: We recommend exiting the game at least 15 minutes before the update. To prevent issues, avoid making purchases within 5 minutes before the server shuts down, as this may affect gameplay or cause account asset loss.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Compensation◢[/p][p]Dark Crystal * 400[/p][p]Compensation eligibility: players who have reached level 6 before the update.[/p][p]We will send the above compensation to your mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. Please check your mailbox.[/p][p][/p][p]◤New Content◢[/p][p]1. A new Simulacrum is now available[/p][p]Limited Simulacrum "Aster" & Limited Weapon "Twin Stars" Coming Soon[/p][p]2. The OreZero Zone - Driftstar Haven in Kailo is now available, along with two new modes: Crystal Core Expedition and Turbulence Tracking.[/p][p]3. New Simulacrum Story "Driftstar Corner - Past & Future"[/p][p]To repair the ""Homecoming,"" you head to Ravenport, where you unexpectedly discover a hidden side of the Nexus Chief Secretary, Aster...[/p][p]Meanwhile, at Driftstar Haven near Kailo's OreZero, a tense negotiation initiated by Ravenport is underway...[/p][p]When the long-standing Pixie legend of Driftstar Haven is finally unveiled, faced with duty and crisis, what decision will you make?[/p][p]An interstellar adventure that traverses past and present, protection and salvation!"[/p][p]4. Lyncis's Simulacrum Dorm scenario mode unlocked.[/p][p]5. New awakened avatars for the Simulacrums: Cocoritter, Zero, Tsubasa, Huma, Samir, and Frigg.[/p][p]6. Added Raid - Traffic Control to the weekly random instance pool.[/p][p]7. Added an Aster Simulacrum instance to Multiverse Hunt and the Leaderboard.[/p][p]8. A new season of Void Abyss is about to begin.[/p][p]9. A new season of Evolution Frontier is about to begin. Added new enemies and mechanisms.[/p][p]10. A new season of Sequential Phantasm is about to begin.[/p][p]11. Added new levels to Bygone Phantasm: Boundless Realm.[/p][p]12. Evolution Vanguard mode: Level 100 Boss - Singer is now available.[/p][p]13. Added Stage 27 - Ground Controller to the Boundless Realm.[/p][p]14. A new Simulacrum Log shortcut has been added to the Simulacrum page.[/p][p]15. The jump key can now be held to quickly ascend in Mecha.[/p][p][/p][p]◤Version Optimization and Bug Fixes◢[/p][p]1. Optimized the mecha scouting rules, with individually tailored scouting parameters for different devices.[/p][p]2. A Hunger alert has been added to the aquarium in the fishing mode (a red dot will now appear when their Hunger drops below a certain threshold).[/p][p]3. Crew Missions can now be auto-submitted upon completion.[/p][p]4. The Backpack page's background has been improved.[/p][p]5. Map usability adjustments have been made.[/p][p]6. Optimized the acceptance of Bounty Missions.[/p][p]7. Optimized the Simulacrum page.[/p][p]8. Optimized the Mecha page.[/p][p]9. Optimized the Mecha controls.[/p][p]10. Fixed an issue where female characters with Height II experienced clipping in the thigh area while walking in the Rose Gift outfit.[/p][p]11. Fixed a rare issue where logging back in after logging out while piloting a Mecha could cause an abnormal Mecha state, resulting in the character falling to their death.[/p][p]12. Fixed a bunch of other issues previously reported.[/p][p]13. Adjusted/optimized some other in-game features.[/p][p]14. Fixed an issue where unlocked accessories appeared as reset after unlocking them.[/p][p]15. Optimized data handling for account transfer, including improvements to the Appearance Hall, cleaning up Crew-related data issues and managing mentor-apprentice relationships.[/p]

notes.title: Ver.5.0 "Kailo Sector" Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a maintenance update to bring you a better gaming experience. After the update, version 5.0 "Kailo Sector" will be released.

◤Update Time◢
May 13, 06:00–10:00 (UTC+0)
(Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)

◤How to Update◢
Resource Update: Once the server goes offline, you can update the game in advance and play the new version as soon as it reopens. We recommend using Wi-Fi for updates on mobile devices.
How to Update

PC:
1. After the server shuts down, manually exit the client and restart it to begin the update.
2. Once the resource update starts downloading, you can minimize the window, and it will continue in the background.
Note: The PC login system has been upgraded. If you experience a login error after updating, restart the client and log out before logging back in. If the issue persists, contact customer support.

Android & iOS:
1. After the server shuts down, download the new version from your app store.
2. Launch the game to start the resource update, which will continue in the background.

Server Shutdown Notice: We recommend exiting the game at least 15 minutes before the update. To prevent issues, avoid making purchases within 5 minutes before the server shuts down, as this may affect gameplay or cause account asset loss.

◤Compensation◢
Dark Crystal * 400
Compensation eligibility: players who have reached level 6 before the update.
We will send the above compensation to your mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. Please check your mailbox.

◤New Content◢
1. Added Main Story – Lost Universe: "Longs to Return"/Side Missions.
For 50 years, the Kailians have struggled, built, and ventured across the universe. The Hope Fleet continues its search for new homes while the once-vibrant Aida fades from the Kailians' memories...
After half a century of drifting and solitude, Kailo finally welcomes a visitor. Could this be the turning point for the Kailians?
2. New Map, Scene, & Modes:
New map Kailo - OreZero added.
Added 1 World Boss, "Queen Xeno," and several new species.
Added the Stellar Expedition Point system, introducing 9 new modes: Zeronium Cube, Gravity Controller, Batesian, Larva Collection, Horror Statue, Gravity Locks, MeteorCore Annihilation, Oscillite Stones and Pillars, and Kimberlite Mine.
3. Added Lyncis's Simulacrum Dorm.
4. Added the Space Support System.
5. Added a permanent PvE mode instance: Multiverse Hunt.
6. Added the event [Newcomer, Set Sail!] (available to all Authorizers after the update).
7. After the update, Evolution Frontier enters a new season.
8. After the update, Sequential Phantasm enters a new season.
9. Added a limited-time Raid instance - Traffic Control.
10. Evolution Vanguard mode: Level 100 Boss Sobek is now available!
11. Added Stage 26 - Void Entity to the Boundless Realm (Sequence).
12. Added new levels to the Bygone Phantasm Boundless Realm.

◤Version Optimization and Bug Fixes◢
1. The Minimum Value for Equipment Advancement has been increased from its original value of ×0.4 to ×0.58 of the Maximum Value, and the probability across all Equipment Advancement ranges has been improved overall.
2. Weapon - Oblivion Star Skill "Starfall Cleave": The off-hand damage of "Dark Star: Frozen," dealing frost damage equal to 450% of ATK every second to nearby targets, has now been increased to 600%.
The final damage boost of "Dark Star: Retrograde" has been increased from 21% to 25%, and the off-hand damage dealt to nearby targets every second has been increased from 490% to 735% of ATK.
Dark Star: Retrograde" flame bullets dealing 420% of ATK per hit have now been increased to 570% of ATK.
Dark Star: Pulse" electric charge attack, consuming 1 stack on hit and dealing 280% of ATK to nearby targets, has now been increased to 500% of ATK. After all charges are cleared, the additional 700% of ATK dealt to nearby targets has been increased to 1,250% of ATK.
3. The purchase limit for select items in the Crystal Dust Store has been doubled: Booster Module, Advancement Module, Potent Omnium Crystal II, Augmentation Factor, and Augment Module Box V.
4. The features allowing players to instantly boost to level 60 and directly access the new map have been disabled.
5. Energy consumption for Mecha movements, such as sprinting, has been reduced.
6. Mechas now have a reduced rate of normal energy recovery and an increased energy recovery rate while out of combat.
7. Mechas will now continuously hover when off the ground instead of slowly descending.
8. When a weapon's normal attack hits a target, it will restore Mechas' energy, which can be restored up to 200%.
9. Mecha energy exceeding 100% will naturally deplete when out of combat.
10. All Mecha shoulder cannon skills no longer have individual cooldowns. Instead, they now share a global cooldown and consume energy.
11. When Mecha's current energy exceeds 100%, the energy consumption of shoulder cannon skills is reduced by 50%.
12. New Mecha Paints and Chip Linkages added.
13. New achievements for the Kailo map added.
14. The Face Editor feature has been optimized, and multiple new Simulacrum preset faces have been added.
15. Added a button to end the challenge quickly in Origin of War.
16. The Network map now supports Simulacrum Roaming.
17. The Echo function can now be used while piloting Mecha.
18. The item Refined Cluster can now be fused into Advanced Clusters.
19. Weapon Batteries I-IV and Matrix Data Packs I-IV can now be recycled.
20. Crew donation item changed to Elemental Ore.
21. Crew Missions optimized.
22. Notifications for incomplete prerequisite missions optimized.
23. Fixed the issue preventing the completion of NPC Celine's related Side Mission.
24. Fixed the Weapon Gallery error in Break From Destiny.
25. Fixed other issues previously reported.
26. Adjusted and optimized some other modes and features.

Please note that to facilitate calculation, all global events listed in the announcements will be displayed in UTC+0 time. If you have difficulty converting time zones, please look up "time zone converter" on Google for a conversion tool. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Tower of Fantasy Team

notes.title: V4.6 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,
 
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.6 Forging a New World will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

◤ Update Time ◢
January 21, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※ Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.
 
◤ Update Method ◤
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can update the game in advance to play the new version as soon as the server opens. It is recommended to update the game when your device is connected to Wi-Fi. Below are the ways to update the game.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: You are recommended to log out 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid any disruption to your gaming experience and potential loss of account assets.
 
◤ Compensation ◢
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update.
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. Please check your Mailbox.
 
◤ Update Contents ◢
◆ New Gameplay
1. New Network's World - Gesthos Smart City
2. New Main Story - Reshape the Future
As we failed to prevent the calamity, our cherished home has become shattered and scarred. If we had a chance, just one shot at making things right, we would give it everything we've got. Though we cannot change the past, we can shape a different future.
3. New World Boss - All-Seeing Eye
4. New mecha and other Overworld gameplays
5. New Simulacrum
Limited Simulacrum, Nemesis Voidpiercer, and a limited weapon, Star of Oblivion, are coming soon.
6. Other new/updated content
1) New Frontier Clash season will start soon.
2) The Void Abyss February Season will begin.
3) The new season of Sequential Phantasm is about to begin.
4) New levels in Sequential Phantasm: Boundless Realm will be activated.
5) Added new floors in Bygone Phantasm Boundless Realm.
6) A new Lv. 100 boss: Minotaur will be added to Evolution Vanguard.
7) Voidpiercer's Simulacrum Dorm is now available.
8) The Eyeshadow feature is now available.
9) Added System Guide to Survival Guide.
10) Altered Weapon Optimizations.

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy Publishing Service Transfer Statement & FAQ
notes.notes:
Since the global launch of Tower of Fantasy in August 2022, millions of Authorizer have downloaded and enjoyed the game. We sincerely thank you everyone for your support and enthusiasm. During this time, we've actively listened to users' feedback and worked to continuously optimize the game experience.
After in-depth discussions, Level Infinite and Perfect World Games have reached an agreement: starting from February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), Perfect World Games will take over the publishing and related services for the Tower of Fantasy.Both parties are committed to ensuring a smooth transition, minimizing any impact on user experience and data privacy. As a token of appreciation for your patience and support, we will issue a gift pack after the completion of this transition and the details will be announced by Perfect World Games soon.
We deeply appreciate your understanding and support during this transition and hope Tower of Fantasy will continue to bring you joy in the future.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1.  Will my account and in-game purchases be affected?
If you agree to transfer your Tower of Fantasy data to a Perfect World Games Account, your data will remain unaffected.
From December 27, 2024, to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page will be available ([url=https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/events/accounttransfer/index.html]https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/events/accounttransfer/index.html[/url]). During this period, you can authorize data transfer via this page. Once data transfer is completed and confirmed by Perfect World Games, your following Tower of Fantasy data will be transferable (including but not limited to):
● Character Data: Your in-game character, including UID, level, appearance, nickname, and simulacra.
● In-Game Items: All items in your inventory, such as equipment, materials, outfits, and vehicles.
● Home-Related: Home structures and combat beasts.
● Purchasable Currency: Unused currency, such as tanium, dark crystals, and gold.
● Purchases: Packs, Monthly Passes, Passes, and other monetized content.
● Game Progress: Main Story Missions, instance progress, achievements, event progress (Returner Event will end), and rewards already claimed.
● Friends and Social Data: Mail, friend lists, blocklists, and Crew-related information.
For the details of the Tower of Fantasy data that can be transferred, please refer to the User Notice on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page.

2.  What if I have multiple characters under one account? Will they all be transferred?
Yes. If you agree to the transfer of your Tower of Fantasy data and complete the authorization process on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page, you will be able to access your data by logging-in to your Perfect World Games Account after Perfect World Games launches the servers.

3.  Will the transfer impact game operations?
We will strive to ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption to users. We will start the app transfer application on each platform on February 14, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC+0). However, the current servers will remain active until February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), when they will officially shut down.
The launch date of Perfect World Games servers will be otherwise announced by Perfect World Games. For more details related to this, please contact Perfect World Games. (email: tofcs_global@pwrd.com)
Perfect World Games will issue a gift pack after the completion of this transition and the details will be announced by Perfect World Games soon.
If you do not agree to the Tower of Fantasy game data transfer or do not make an authorization decision before April 24, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0), please refer to point 7 below.

4.  How will I access the game after the transfer?
If you agree to transfer your Tower of Fantasy data to a Perfect World Games Account and complete the authorization process as instructed on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page, you can access the game by log-in your Perfect World Games Account in the following ways once Perfect World Games servers go live:
iOS, Android, Samsung, and Steam: Update your current game client to the latest version and log in with your Perfect World Games Account without any additional actions.
PC: Download the new launcher and game version from the official website ([url=https://tof.perfectworld.com/]Tower of Fantasy | Open World RPG[/url]) to access the game.
Epic Games: Since the Epic Games platform will no longer be supported, you will need to otherwise download the game on the PC or Steam.
Additional note: please refer to the User Notice on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page for the details and instructions of the authorization process.

5.  What is the transfer timeline?
● December 27, 2024: "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page goes live.
● December 27, 2024 to February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Data transfer and decision modification period.
● February 14, 2025 04:00 (UTC+0): Transition of store/app publishing rights; in-game top-up services disabled.
● February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Level Infinite servers officially shut down; original Customer Service and related services discontinued.
● The go live date for the new server will be announced by Perfect World Games. 
<link: [url=https://tof.perfectworld.com/eneu/m/news/notice/20241218/254158.shtml]https://tof.perfectworld.com/eneu/m/news/notice/20241218/254158.shtml[/url]>.
● February 23 16:00 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0) (Extended Data Transfer Confirmation Period): Extended authorization confirmation period to give users more time for additional data transfers.
※ You can report any unresolved issues in the Level Infinite version of the game via email (support@toweroffantasy-global.com) until April 24, 2025, at 16:00 (UTC+0). After that, this email feedback channel will officially close.
● April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Final closure of "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page.
● April 30, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Tower of Fantasy data for which authorization was declined or not completed will be deleted.

6.  Why are purchase services closing early?
To secure users' in-game data, in-game top-up services will be disabled in advance as stated in Section 5 of this statement.

7.  What happens to my Tower of Fantasy data if I don't authorize the transfer?
Your Tower of Fantasy data under your current Level Infinite Account will be deleted on April 30, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0) and cannot be recovered if you do not agree to transfer your Tower of Fantasy data to Perfect World Games, or you failed to complete the authorization process as instructed.
To avoid the loss of your Tower of Fantasy data or affecting your normal gaming experience, please consider carefully before confirming your decision.
Alternatively, you can request data deletion in advance via the in-game Settings > Compliance Management > Data Privacy section, and we will assist you in completing the process.
For details on the transfer and protection of Tower of Fantasy data, please refer to the User Notice on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page.

8.  Does this transfer affect all regions?
Yes.Perfect World Games will take over the publishing and operations for Tower of Fantasy in all regions where the game's services are currently provided by Level Infinite. For updates, Please follow the community channels and official website ([url=https://tof.perfectworld.com/]Tower of Fantasy | Open World RPG[/url]) for more information.

Level Infinite

notes.title: Important: Notice of Publisher and Operation Changes
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,
Level Infinite would like to share some important news about Tower of Fantasy. Starting from February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), the game will be published, operated, and managed by Perfect World Games , the parent company of Hotta Studio.

Please accept the transfer of your Tower of Fantasy data to a Perfect World Games Account in order to ensure your game progress, virtual currency, items, and purchased services remain unaffected.
We're committed to making the transition to a new publisher for Tower of Fantasy as seamless as possible. Rest assured, our servers will remain active until February 23, 2025, at 16:00 (UTC+0), ensuring you can continue enjoying the same high-quality gaming experience you've come to love.
Here is the important information you need to know:

1. How Will This Affect Tower of Fantasy Data?
To allow users to continue playing Tower of Fantasy with their existing gaming progress, we will open a "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page from December 27, 2024 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).

Users who agree to transfer their data will have their Tower of Fantasy data migrated to the new publisher. Users who do not agree to the transfer or fail to authorize the transfer within the specified timeframe will have their Tower of Fantasy data deleted.

For details on what Tower of Fantasy Data is transferred, please refer to the User Notice on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page.

2. How to Authorize Data Transfer?
2.1 For users logging in via LEVEL INFINITE PASS, Apple, Google, Facebook, X, Line, or Steam:

Users can authorize the transfer and link to a Perfect World Account by accessing the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page through an in-game pop-up after logging in.
Note: The authorization page will be open from December 27, 2024 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).  You need to confirm on this page whether you agree to the Tower of Fantasy Data Transfer. After the change of publisher "Tower of Fantasy" will adhere to the new publisher's privacy policy. Please read the "Perfect World Games Privacy Policy" carefully before authorizing data transfer.
EN:  [url=https://static.perfectworldgames.com/mapi/privacy/privacy.html]PRIVACY POLICY[/url]
JA：[url=https://static.perfectworldgames.com/privacy/privacy_ja.html]プライバシー・ポリシー[/url]

2.2 For users using guest accounts or Epic Games accounts:
Note: Due to platform restrictions on guest data and the discontinuation of support for the Epic Games platform, data cannot be directly transferred.
Those users must first link their account to a LEVEL INFINITE PASS account by February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), and then complete the authorization process on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page to avoid data loss.

3. What If I Do Not Consent to the Tower of Fantasy Data Transfer?
You can choose to wait until the Level Infinite server shuts down without making a decision, or you can opt to decline the data transfer authorization on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page. After selecting, you will still be able to play until the Level Infinite servers shut down on February 23, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0). All related Tower of Fantasy data under your Level Infinite account will be deleted on April 30, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0).
To avoid loss of your gaming rights or affecting your normal gaming experience, please consider carefully before confirming your decision.
Alternatively, you can request data deletion in advance via the in-game Settings > Compliance Management > Data Privacy section, and we will assist you in completing the process.

4. Can I Modify My Transfer Decision?
You can modify your transfer decision through “Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page before February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0). After this date, changes to your authorization decision will no longer be permitted.

5. Publisher Transition Timeline
● December 27, 2024: "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page goes live.
● December 27, 2024 to February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Data transfer and decision modification period.
● February 14, 2025 04:00 (UTC+0): Transition of store/app publishing rights; in-game top-up services disabled.
● February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Level Infinite servers officially shut down; original Customer Service and related services discontinued.
● The go live date for the new server will be announced by Perfect World Games.
 <link: [url=https://tof.perfectworld.com/eneu/m/news/notice/20241218/254158.shtml]https://tof.perfectworld.com/eneu/m/news/notice/20241218/254158.shtml[/url]>.
● February 23 16:00 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0) (Extended Data Transfer Confirmation Period): Extended authorization confirmation period to give users more time for additional data transfers.
● April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Final closure of "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page.
● April 30, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Tower of Fantasy data for which authorization was declined or not completed will be deleted.

6. Who to Contact About Your Data Rights?
● Before data transfer:
Before >February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), we will continue to handle game operations and Tower of Fantasy data. For questions or data rights inquiries, please refer to the User Agreement ( https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/UserAgreement.html) and Privacy Policy ( https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/PrivacyPolicy.html) or contact us.

● After data transfer:
After February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), the new publisher will take over game operations.The new publisher will also handle Tower of Fantasy data management.In case of any inquiries or if you wish to exercise your data subject rights, please do not hesitate to contact Perfect World Games.
Please note that once the transition is complete, your User Agreement with us will no longer apply to the game. Any terms and conditions will be governed by the new user agreement established by the new publisher. Starting from February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), please contact the new publisher directly for any issues, complaints, or disputes related to game operations.

7. How to Contact
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this notice, please contact us via in-game Customer Service or mail before February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).

Thank you for your continued support. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Please stay tuned for further updates to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

Level Infinite

notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,
 
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.4.5 Decoder of Time will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

November 26, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.
 
[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can update the game in advance to play the new version as soon as the server opens. It is recommended to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the ways to update the game.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server Shutdown: You are recommended to log out 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid any disruption to your gaming experience and potential loss of account assets.
 
[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals

notes.title: V4.4 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,
 
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.4 Reality in Restraint will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:
 
◤ Update Time ◢
October 29, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.
 
◤ Update Method ◢
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the server is back up. We also recommend that you update the game when your device is connected to Wi-Fi. Below are the detailed update methods.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: It is recommended that you prepare to log out of the game 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid a negative gaming experience and account asset losses.
 
◤ Compensation ◢
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update.
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. Please check your Mailbox.
 
◤ Update Contents ◢
◆ New Gameplay
1. New Network's World - Indoor Zone
2. New Main Story - Reshape the Future: Aida Blue
In the vast underground transportation network of Aesperia, a tide of Aberrants has appeared. We fell into a trap set by Asurada while navigating it. To resolve the crisis at hand, I ventured into the foundational layer, only to encounter something unexpected: The truth hidden within File O49 was revealed, and the plan to reshape reality... This is a requiem...
3. New World Boss - Defender: Gunner
4. New Permanent Challenge Gameplay Instance - Final Trial
5. New Simulacrum
A new Limited Simulacrum, Asurada, and a limited weapon, Hellfire, are coming soon.
6. Other new/updated contents
1) New Frontier Clash season will start soon.
2) The Void Abyss November Season will begin.
3) A new season of Sequential Phantasm is about to begin.
4) New levels in Sequential Phantasm Boundless Realm will be activated.
5) A new Lv. 97 boss, Darkness: Merbelle, will be added to Evolution Vanguard.
6) Bygone Phantasm Boundless Realm Lv. 64 will be activated.
7) Roslyn's Simulacrum Dorm is now available.
8) New interactive gameplays, such as Detective X's Investigation, Battle Simulator, Laser Predicament, and Survival Battle, will be added to the network's world.
9) New Simulacrum Roaming gameplay will be added: Dispatch Simulacra to roam various areas. When roaming, Simulacra will assist you in completing exploration and earning rewards. The efficiency of Simulacrum roaming is affected by the degree of map exploration and the Simulacrum's map traits.
10) Story skip feature will be added: This feature will pop up upon completion of the "Companion" mission. Players who have completed the "Companion" mission can click on the newly added story skip button in the Overworld map.
11) Weapon optimization and enhancement for Spear of Longinus, Salvation, Calm Waters, and Freeflow.
13) The issue of the missing purple particle effect around the "Nomeowdic Star" outfit has been fixed.
14) Optimization of Crew Honor Point requirements.

◆ New events (please see the online info)

notes.title: V4.3 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.3 Ethereal Rose will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
September 19, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the server is back up. We also recommend to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Detailed update instructions are provided below.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server Shutdown: We suggest you prepare to log out 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid any disruption to your gaming experience and potential loss of account assets.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
2. Lin's synesthesia 4 stars effect issue compensation: 300 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. Added Main Story - Surface Layer, Clouds of Suspense
Just as the turmoil from the Public Security and Aurora Industries has subsided, a new crisis has emerged: Asurada... Team X of the Federation Nexus... Faced with this new crisis, a message from ""Plotti"" suddenly came through. Without any hesitation, I followed ""her"" instructions...
2. Introducing 5 new gameplays: Tuning in Turmoil, Cycling, Probability Clash, Paper Airplane, and Mid-Autumn Fireworks.
3. Added a new Simulacrum

10) Personal Card Feature Enhancement: Added weapon display switch, filter, and quirk function.
11) The Skyride Express can be used across different areas.
12) Key Improvement Content of the Version:
a. Appointed Research projects that can be completed multiple times do not require additional materials for repeated completion (except for energy activation chargers).
b. The Adventure page has been revamped.
c. Mission interface adjustment.
13) Optimize Lin's Synesthesia 4 stars effect for damage in Apex League and Joint Operation.  
14) Mi-a's Kitchen buff effect changed to apply to all attributes, duration extended to 3 hours.

[h2]◤ Update Contents ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. New Network's World - Central District
2. New World Boss - Ground Controller
3. New Main Story - Behind the Neon Lights
The city lights are shining as brilliantly as ever, but hidden under the mask of prosperity, dark plots gradually surface. I realize that we're caught in a mess: the Public Security, the Federation Nexus, and other troubles come one after another... What exactly is recorded in the files we got from Aurora Industries? As I delve deeper into the foundational layer, I discover a strange truth, something that goes against everyone's understanding... The Gesthos Network World... Is it virtual?.. Or is it the reality?..
4. New Simulacrum
Limited Simulacrum, Nola, and a limited weapon, Rumble, are coming soon.
5. New Simulacrum Dorm Feature

5) A new Lv. 95 boss: Gaia will be added to Evolution Vanguard.
6) Personal Card feature will be improved and will now support settings customization.
7) The exchange limits of booster modules and advancement modules using Crystal Dust will be adjusted.
8) In the version sign-in event, "Gesthos Battle Box" will be introduced. Upon opening the box, you will obtain fortress equipment with completely fixed sub-stats.
9) Daily gameplay will be decreased and some gameplay will be optimized or removed:
a. Energy Crystal Dust (Blue) and Energy Crystal Dust (Purple) will be replaced by Energy Crystal Dust (Orange) at a fixed ratio. All items originally obtainable using Energy Crystal Dust (Blue) and Energy Crystal Dust (Purple) will now be obtainable using Energy Crystal Dust (Orange).
b. Classic Mode of the Joint Operation gameplay will be removed and Balanced Mode will be fully optimized.
c. Wormhole gameplay will be removed.
d. The rewards for Normal and Hard modes of Frontier Clash will be combined into the daily first-clear reward for the Balanced mode of Joint Operation.
e. Rift Difficulty of Void Rift gameplay will be removed.
f. The difficulty levels of each type of Dimensional Trials is combined into one difficulty level.
10) The chat channel will now support Arabic.

notes.title: V4.2 Event Announcements
notes.notes:
Hello, Authorizers!
Enjoy this cool summer loaded with tons of awesome rewards! The brand new V4.2 "Cool Coastline" will be dropping along with ToF's 2nd anniversary celebrations. There's even a swimsuit party waiting for you!
New limited-time events will begin after the server update. Please read the following Event Rules or view the in-game event and rewards panel for details.

[h2]◤ Seaside Summer Bash ◢[/h2]
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 6, 2024 (after version update) to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Participation Conditions:
Complete the Ecological Station Intruders main story to unlock the event page.
◆ Event Introduction:
Eight limited-time gameplays will be available during the event period: Login Rewards, Beach Volleyball, Cheers! Summer Dance Off!, Fruit Attack, A Song of Water, Bonding Summer Camp, Palmside Onslaught, and Floating Bumpers.
Event rewards: Participate in the events to earn Coral Coins, which can be exchanged in the Store for the Rocktooth Shark vehicle, Iron Blood and Milkshake dorm furniture, Blue Dolphin Sunglasses accessory, personal card backgrounds, personal card picture frames, Gesthos Battle Boxes, and more. During the event, you can also get Gold Nucleus ×80, Proof of Purchase ×120, Red Nucleus ×17, Special voucher ×24, the Fruit Can accessory, Starlight face pattern, Memory Medium, stickers, and more.

1. Login Rewards
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 6, 2024 (after version update) to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
Log into the game for a specified number of days to claim corresponding rewards during the event period.
Log in for a total of three days to get Gold Nucleus ×80.
Log in for a total of six days to receive Gesthos Battle Box ×1 (Upon opening, you can choose one of Flame, Frost, Volt, or Physical battle boxes. Opening one element battle box will give you eight pieces of equipment with corresponding stats, including armguards, suit, legguards, boots, helmet, handguards, pocket, and shoulderguards)
Log in for a total of eight days to get Proof of Purchase ×80.
Log in for a total of 10 days to get Special voucher ×10.
Log in for a total of 15 days to get Red nucleus ×10.

2. Beach Volleyball
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 6, 2024 (after version update) to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
During the event, participate in Beach Volleyball event to get Dandelion Badges as well as Coral Coins that you can exchange for items in the Store.

3. Cheers! Summer Dance Off!
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 11, 2024, 3:00 to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. A Summer Music Party will be held on the cruise ship from 12:00 to 24:00 server time daily. Miss Anka will be your DJ and will bring you a fantastic music show and a spectacular firework display.
2. Dance on the cruise ship and earn 400 Coral Coins every 10 minutes. You can ear a daily limit of 4,800 Coral Coins.
3. Dance daily for 30 minutes to receive two Sticker Box III shards.

4. Fruit Attack
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 13, 2024, 3:00 to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. During the event, five types of fruits will respawn every 30 minutes in the four event areas within the Gesthos network.
2. Fruits will be launched when attacked by Authorizers. When Authorizers defeat a fruit within the event area, they will receive the corresponding fruit slices and Coral Coins as rewards. However, if fruits are launched out of the event area, Authorizers will not receive any rewards for that fruit.
3. There are several highlighted reward areas within the event zone. If an Authorizer manages to knock a fruit into these areas, the fruit will be defeated immediately and the Authorizer will receive more generous rewards. Fruits defeated in the reward area also has a chance to drop a fruit transformation card.
4. Defeated fruits will drop fruit slices, which can be used to exchange for corresponding prizes on the event's main page. There is a daily limit for obtaining fruit slices, and the limit is shared among the five types.

5. A Song of Water
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 20, 2024, 3:00 to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. After the game starts, one random Authorizer will carry the "Waterbomb."
2. The Authorizer holding the "Waterbomb" can transfer it to another Authorizer by getting close to them.
3. The "Waterbomb" will explode after a while, and the last holder of the "Waterbomb" will be eliminated.
4. Whenever an Authorizer is eliminated, the "Waterbomb" will respawn on another random Authorizer in the game. This continues until only one Authorizer is left in the game.

6. Bonding Summer Camp
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
August 29, 2024 (after version update) to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. Each game involves 8 participants, divided into 4 teams, with two players in each team.
2. Once the game begins, watermelons and pineapples will randomly appear on the field. Players need to pick them up to earn points.
3. A laser will form between team members, and the length of the laser changes based on the distance between team members. When this laser touches players from another team, that player will be eliminated and will drop some of the fruits they are carrying.
4. During the event, players are ranked based on the points they've earned and the number of times they are defeated.

7. Palmside Onslaught
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
September 3, 2024, 3:00 to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. A different number of coconuts will be available for each turn. Choose the direction you want to advance in to get coconuts.
2. If more than one player chooses to move to the same lot, no one will get coconuts.
3. Before the game starts, each player will draw three random function cards. These cards can be used to give themselves points or interfere with the opponent's move at each turn that they are up against each other.
4. At the end of the gameplay, rewards will be distributed based on the total number of coconuts obtained.

8. Floating Bumpers
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
September 10, 2024, 3:00 to September 19, 2024, 2:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. The event area consists of floating blocks. When the floating block is touched, it will disappear after a period of time. Please move to safety before the floating block disappears.
2. Use items and buffs to survive until the end!
3. The floating blocks, event items, and buffs will refresh every 30 seconds.
4. There are 8 participants per game. Wanderers are ranked based on the order in which they fall, and a different amount of event currency will be distributed based on their ranking.

notes.title: V4.1 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizer,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.1 The Masked Heart will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
July 2, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward depending on the maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the server is back up. We also recommend to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the detailed update methods.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: You are recommended to prepare to log out of the game 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid a negative gaming experience and account asset losses.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update.
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. New world boss: Phantasmic Scorpion
2. New Simulacrum Story: Wednesday's Espionage!
Anka sent me an invitation through the private Wednesday channel. Not sure what she's up to. It's not just Anka. I need to learn about the other members of Wednesday as well as their goals, and find out why I was recruited.

 I need answers before I can decide my next move in the Gesthos network.

 And this is my opportunity.
3. New Simulacrum
Limited Simulacrum, Anka, and limited weapon, Poppin' Stick, are coming soon.
4. Other new/updated content
1) New Frontier Clash season starting soon.
2) New Origin of War season starting soon.

7) A new Lv. 94 boss: Iron Tomb will be added to Evolution Vanguard.
8) Some gameplay rewards will be changed to Augment Module Box V.
9) Augment Module Box V available in Crystal Dust Store.
10) New Titan part exoskeleton is available.
11) Climb does not consume endurance, the endurance consumption of jumping climb greatly decreases.
12) Physical vehicles add the function of gravitational orbit adhesion.
13) The maximum number of friends is increased to 100.
14) Support for wearing more accessories simultaneously.
15) The automatic cruise control function of the Speedy Lightwheel vehicle is optimized.

notes.title: V4.0 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizer,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V4.0 Gesthos Sector will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
May 28, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward depending on the maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the server is back up. We also recommend to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the detailed update methods.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: You are recommended to prepare to log out of the game 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to a negative gaming experience and account asset losses.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. New Map: The Gesthos Network World
2. Added Main Story - Link to Origin and Side Story Missions
The unexpected outage of the Gesthos network has everyone on edge. As a result, Hykros has declared a state of emergency.
 In order to uncover the truth behind Shirli's unconsciousness, I've accepted my duty as the Authorizer of Hykros. Entering the virtual world constructed by the Network System, I will investigate the cause of the Network's anomalies.
3. New Simulacrum
Limited Simulacrum, Roslyn, and a limited weapon, Calm Waters, are coming soon.
4. Other new/updated content
1) New Frontier Clash season starting soon
2) New Void Abyss season starting soon
3) Floor 60 in Bygone Phantasm Boundless Realm
4) Sequential Phantasm: Boundless Realm Lv. 12 activated
5) Reduced difficulty for the raid instance: Element Alert
6) New Evolution Vanguard gameplay
7) New feature: Supercomputing Evolution
8) Augment module box III removed from Crystal Dust Store
9) New Authorizer's Terminal gameplay

notes.title: V3.8 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. V3.8 Celestial Destiny will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
April 30, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward depending on the maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the server is back up. We also recommend to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the detailed update methods.
◆ PC:
1. After the servers are shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it, then update the launcher.
2. Please click Update on the launcher. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The PC version's launcher has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the launcher, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be updated in this version. After the servers are shut down, please download the new app version in your device's application store.
2. After launching the game and starting the update resources' download, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server Maintenance: We recommend you to prepare to log out 15 minutes before the update. Please refrain from making any purchases in the 5 minutes before the servers shutdown to avoid a negative gaming experience and any loss of your account's assets.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. Added Main Story - Domain 9: Gentle Breeze & Clear Skies
A brief respite from the curse of Darkness brings gentle breeze and clear skies. Beyond the celestial gate, shadows lurk in Hykros as the Heirs sharpen their knives. Shirli is believed to be the culprit behind the unusual silence of Gesthos. We must find a way to wake Shirli up before things get worse...
2. Added a new Simulacrum
Limited Simulacrum, Ji Yu, and a limited weapon, Freeflow, are coming soon.
3. Other new/updated content
1) New Frontier Clash season starting soon
2) Fog Reconstruction Season Three starting soon
3) New Void Abyss season starting soon
4) New Origin of War season starting soon
5) Floor 59 in Bygone Phantasm Boundless Realm
6) Sequential Phantasm: Boundless Realm Lv. 11 activated
7) New limited-time Raid instance: Element Alert
8) Equipment enhancement level cap increased to 65
9) New Equipment Augment parts: engines/goggles
10) Augment module box IV available in Crystal Dust Store
11) Armor management module available permanently in Store

◆ New events (please see the online info)
We will start a series of new activities and events after the version update. The detailed rules for the event can be found in V3.8 Event Announcements.

1. Celestial Destiny

◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
May 7, 2024, 03:00 to May 14, 2024, 02:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. The game is divided into the preparation phase, hiding phase, and searching phase.
2. During the preparation phase, you can choose to be an Optical Agent or a Concealed Operative. If multiple players choose to be an Optical Agent, two of them will be randomly selected. If no one chooses to be an Optical Agent, then two persons will be randomly selected from all players. If only two persons chooses to be an Optical Agent, they will automatically assume the role without any random selection.
3. During the hiding phase, all Concealed Operatives can move freely to hide after they are teleported from the preparation hall to the event hall.
4. The searching phase will begin after the hiding phase. The Optical Agent needs to search and capture all Concealed Operatives within a limited amount of time. If all Concealed Operatives are successfully captured within the designated time, then Optical Agents and Agent's Assistants will win. If there are still Concealed Operatives, then Concealed Operatives and Concealed Viruses will win.
5. The first 2 captured Concealed Operatives can choose to become an Agent's Assistant or a Concealed Virus. From the 3rd one onwards, they can only become a Concealed Virus by default.
6. Settlement Rewards
Optical Agents: Rewards for winning and losing, plus rewards for the number of operatives captured. As long as agents capture a good number of operatives, the rewards will be handsome even if they didn't win.
Concealed Operatives, Concealed Viruses, and Agent's Assistants: Rewards for winning and losing, plus rewards for the duration of time they survive. The longer they stay alive, the better the rewards are. When captured, they should help their teammates win.

1. Collection Hunt
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
March 12, 2024 (after version update) to April 29, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. During the event, a mission clue will be released every day at 13:00 (Server Time). Solve the puzzle based on the clue to unlock the corresponding rumor and exploration rewards.
2. The first Executor in the server to solve the puzzle will be recorded in the rumor introduction, receiving a title available during the event.
3. Missions with question marks as names are secret missions. There are no clue hints to secret missions. You can obtain the corresponding clues by solving other puzzles and talking to NPCs.
4. Clues can be accumulated and missions can be completed at any time during the event.

2. Town Tour Sweepstakes
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
March 12, 2024 (after version update) to April 29, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. During the event, complete expedition missions to earn expedition progress and star disks.
Expedition Progress: You can claim an expedition reward each time your expedition progress reaches 100%.
Star disks are used to participate in the Star Wheel Award and refresh expedition missions. Activating the Star Wheel Award costs one star disk each time.
2. During the event, there will be an additional opportunity each week to reset all expedition missions. By using it, all completed and uncompleted opportunities will be refreshed.
3. Spend one star disk to refresh all unfinished missions. During the event, you can refresh up to ten times. Please pay attention to the limit.
4. In the Star Wheel Award, draw specific pattern combinations and tap to claim the rewards. If you start the Star Wheel Draw again without claiming the rewards, your current patterns will be reset.
Pattern Lock: You can lock a pattern by tapping on its corresponding slot. The locked pattern will stay in place when activated and will not rotate with other patterns.
Pattern Combination: Tap the question mark icon at the top left corner of the Star Wheel Award page to view different pattern combinations and their rewards.

3. Defense Breach
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
March 19, 2024, 03:00 to April 29, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. Complete the Defense Breach daily mission to obtained Defensive Protocol admission tickets. Defensive Protocol features the following bosses: Ying Zhao, Darkness: Taotie, and the 10th Angel.
2. You can participate in the event by yourself or as a team. Each entry costs one admission ticket. When entering as a team, the team captain's admission ticket will be used.
After defeating a boss, the player who used the admission ticket will have the boss’s difficulty level increased by 1. The higher the difficulty level, the better the rewards will be upon defeating it.
Ying Zhao: The highest difficulty level is 20
Darkness: Taotie: The highest difficulty level is 10.
The 10th Angel: The highest difficulty level is 5.
3. You have 6 assist attempts each day, where you can assist and earn assist rewards and points. However, no rewards or points will be given after exceeding 6 assists.
4. Each time you participate in Defensive Protocol, you will earn points based on the result and damage dealt. At the end of the event, you will receive an extra event reward based on your points ranking.
5. For every 2 Defensive Protocols - Ying Zhao consumed, you will obtain 1 Defensive Protocol - Taotie consumed. For every 2 Defensive Protocols - Taotieconsumed, you will obtain 1 Defensive Protocol - the 10th Angel. If the process ends in an irregular way (e.g. disconnecting without reconnecting), ticket consumption will not be counted.
6. Players who score more than 200 points in the instance can claim the Defense Breach participation reward.

4. Operation Breakout
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
03-28-2024, after update to 04-29-2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. Based on the rules of Break From Destiny, players have to work together to defeat the final boss.
2. During each battle, 7 random guarding enemies will spawn. Defeat them to obtain player buffs.
3. As the boss cannot be attacked in the initial phase, try to prioritize defeating the guarding enemies.
4. Defeat the boss before the countdown ends to obtain victory rewards that can be exchanged for other items in the Redemption Store.
5. Players will be ranked based on the damage dealt to the final boss. Those who deal no damage to the boss will not be ranked.

5. Sequence Reset
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
April 16, 2024, 03:00 to April 29, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
