notes.title: v3.7 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,

Thank you for your support of Tower of Fantasy! In order to bring you a better gaming experience, we will be updating game resources and performing a server maintenance. After the update, we will launch version 3.7 ""Evangelion Fantasy"".
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤Update Time◢[/h2]
March 12, 03:50–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤Update Method◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the servers are shut down, you can complete the game update in advance so that you can experience the new version as soon as the servers are back up. We also recommend that you do this in a Wi-Fienvironment. Below are the detailed update methods.
◆ PC:
1. After the servers are shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it, then update the launcher.
2. Please click Update on the launcher. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The PC version's launcher has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the launcher, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be updated in this version. After the servers are shut down, please download the new app version in your device's application store.
2. After launching the game and starting the update resources' download, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server Maintenance: We recommend you to prepare to log out 15 minutes before the update. Please refrain from making any purchases in the 5 minutes before the servers shutdown to avoid a negative gaming experience and any loss of your account's assets.

[h2]◤Compensation◢[/h2]
1. Server shutdown compensation: 500 Dark Crystals
Client update compensation: 200 Dark Crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who have reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

The arrival of a massive creature through the spacetime rift shattered the daily tranquility. An intruder known as the 'familiar' appeared outside of Mirroria! In the face of this crisis, a young boy controlling a universal humanoid weapon steps forward, engaging in a desperate battle...

notes.title: v3.5 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. v3.5 Winter's Electrifying Rhapsody will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
December 21, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward depending on the maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can update the game in advance to play the new version as soon as the server opens. It is recommended to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the ways to update the game.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the launcher.
2. Please tap Update on the launcher. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The PC version's launcher has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the launcher, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be updated in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in your device'sapplication store.

Five limited-time gameplays will be available during the event  period: Grand Chapters, Wintery Gift, Dancing Craze, Reindeer Express, and  Snowball Battlegrounds. Participate in the event to claim serenade notes which can be exchanged in the Store for rewards.
Event rewards: Store tokens can be exchanged for the Fenrir Haute Couture skin Fluffy White Chocolate, the weapon skin Zero Decibel, red nuclei, special vouchers, gold nuclei, the equipment fortress tactics eyepiece, the equipment microreactor, the equipment fortress exoskeleton, augment module boxes II, augmentation factors, red snow plum transformation items, and more. Participate in the event for a chance to obtain the avatar Hanna, the avatar frame Chief Park Ranger, the chat bubble The Doctor's Assistant, a random Shape-Shifting Gun, new party dance steps, and more.
1. Grand Chapters
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
December  21, 2023 (after version update) to January 8, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆Event Introduction:
(i) The event consists of six phases, with one new phase being unlocked every two days. The sixth phase unlocks once you have completed the previous five phases.
(ii) During each phase, event missions and boss challenges will  be activated over a span of two days. Complete all content of the current  phase to view exclusive memory videos and claim rewards.
(iii) During the event, complete event missions to obtain Memory  Shards. Equip Memory Shards in Support slots to get a variety of buffs that  help you challenge event bosses.
(iv) During the  event, complete event missions, challenge event bosses, and open chests in  the Overworld for a chance to obtain Memory Shards.

2. Wintery Gift
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
December  21, 2023 (after version update) to January 8, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆Event Introduction:
(i) As the year ends and the cold sets in, the lucky snow comes to visit bearing gifts. Legend has it that a snow monster wearing a red hat and jacket will arrive with the lucky snow, bringing with it lots of lucky snow giftboxes. Thanks to Hykros' help, the giftboxes have been secretly placed around the world, waiting to be opened by a warrior. Opening the giftboxes at specific times yields surprising gifts!
(ii) Lucky snow giftboxes have been placed in specific areas in Aesperia, Mirroria, and Innars. After the event starts, from 12:00 to 22:00 server time, once every 2 hours, you can go to these areas and open the giftboxes to obtain rewards.
(iii) The collection time for each round of giftboxes lasts for 30 minutes; rewards cannot be obtained outside this timeframe. You may open up to 20 giftboxes every day; no more giftboxes can be opened once the limit has been reached.
(iv) Each time, you have a chance to obtain one of the following  giftboxes: Fluffy giftbox, Chubby giftbox, and Warm giftbox. Each type of  giftbox contains different rewards. You can preview the rewards a giftbox may  contain in your backpack. Open the giftbox to randomly obtain one of the  possible rewards.

3. Dancing Craze
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
December  22, 2023, 03:00 to January 8, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆Event Introduction:
During the event, from 21:00 to midnight server time every day, hit the dancefloor at the Oasis Club livehouse and obtain 1 Mystery Party Gift every 5 minutes, up to 5 per day. Open it for a chance to obtain new dance moves and the Oasis Club's commemorative avatar frame.

4. Reindeer Express
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
December  25, 2023, 03:00 to January 8, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆Event Introduction:
Each game involves 8 players, divided into 4 groups of 2. In each group, one player is tasked with delivering gifts across the road, while the other player is in charge of driving a car on the road.
Each game lasts for 90 seconds. Once the time is up, the groups  will be ranked based on the points they have earned. Points can be earned in  the following two ways.
(i) Delivering  gifts: the more gifts you carry, the slower you move; at the same time, you  also earn more points for successfully delivering the gifts across the road.  You may carry up to 3 gifts at any given time, with larger gifts granting  more points.
(ii) Driving:  While driving a car, you can ram other players carrying gifts across the  road, earning points as well as knocking out the gifts in their hands.
Try to earn as many points as you can! The more points your  group earns, the more rewards you will obtain.

5. Snowball Battlegrounds
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
December  28, 2023, 03:00 to January 8, 2024, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆Event Introduction:
(i) Preparation Phase: A total of 8 players will be matched and placed into the same room. Once everyone has joined, a random player will be chosen as Sweetie, while the rest become Mi-a.
(ii) Battle Phase: There are 8 rounds in a match. In each round,  the Sweetie may fire snowballs at any chosen direction. Mi-a players have to  dodge snowballs, utilizing covers in the area. Mi-a players hit by a snowball  are instantly eliminated.
(iii) Tally  Phase: Based on the number of surviving Mi-a players, each player receives  corresponding rewards.

notes.title: v3.4 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. v3.4 Butterfly in the Abyss will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
November 21, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward depending on the maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can update the game in advance to play the new version as soon as the server opens. It is recommended to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the ways to update the game.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the login system.
2. Please tap Update on the login system. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The login system of the PC version has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the login system, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in the application store of your device.
2. After launching the game and starting the download of the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: It is recommended that you prepare to log out of the game 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid a negative game experience and account asset losses.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
Compensation for voiceover issue in main story: Red Nucleus: Harmonious Flutistry x5
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. Marshville's Forbidden County Unlocked
The Marshville map unlocks today, introducing new areas such as the Pass of Ao, Skyburnace, Ambersnow Canyon, Sorrow Cavern, the Black Jade Ruin, and many more. A new world boss Merbelle and new creatures such as rockwings and hidewings are also unlocked, as well as a new exploration mode Phases of the Moon.
2. Added Main Story - Domain 9 Frost-Covered Marshville (Part 2). Also added the Marshville Side Missions.
To derail Nan Yin's plot and unearth the truth behind the Hendeca County Calamity, Ji Yu resumes the investigation into the Forbidden County and reignites the Skyburnace, dispelling the gloom above Hendeca County. She goes deeper into Hendeca County in search of the key clue about the Darkness buried under the snow in the Forbidden County...
3. Added a world boss, Darkness: Merbelle, a story boss, and some new creatures
4. 3 new puzzle-solving elements have been made available and the Field of Execution has been unlocked.
5. Added a new Simulacrum, Nan Yin.
Limited Simulacrum, Nan Yin, and a limited weapon, Purple Bamboo, are coming soon.
6. Other new/updated content
1) The new season of Sequential Phantasm will begin in December 9
2) The new season of Frontier Clash: Evolution Mode has begun, with new gameplay elements and new enemies added
3) The new season of Void Abyss will begin in December
4) Balanced out the difficulty of Joint Operation instances

1. The Golden Games
◆ [h2]Event Time:[/h2]
11-21-2023, after version update to 12-11-2023, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
1. The event is an 8-player match. Teams are allowed to participate.
2. From the starting point, Wanderers will pass through 5 stages one by one. Rankings and rewards will be determined according to the time taken to reach the finish line.
    About the Stages
      There are 5 stages with different gameplays and traps:
    Going High and Low: There are seesaws everywhere. The inclination angle of both sides of the seesaw will change based on the number and position of the Wanderers standing on it. You need to cross the seesaws to reach the next stage.
    Zig-Zag Maneuvering: This is a track filled with punching devices and moving obstacles. You can only run on it.
    High-Speed Gliding: Move forward using the Relic Jetboard and avoid the obstacles and traps along the way.
    Up to the Skies: Equip yourself with Speedwalkers and climb up to the top of the building. Falling Stones, Flashbangs, and Speed Boosters will drop from the top randomly. Reach the top of the building to complete the stage.
    Careful of Obstacles: Drive the Aidan Knight vehicle toward the finish line. Walls, Shields, and Speed Boosters will keep appearing there. You need to avoid the moving walls and be the first to reach the finish line to win.

2. The Wanderer who destroys the other's fortress wins.
3. Charge regenerates over time, for a maximum of 30. Creatures cannot be summoned without sufficient charge.
4. Different units on the field trigger different buffs. Combine decks to win!

◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the launcher.
2. Please tap Update in the launcher. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The PC version's launcher has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the launcher, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:

- Compensation Eligibility: Players who reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplays

Nonetheless, Longjian Pavilion and the Department of Yuheng stand strong, leading its citizens in the never-ending fight against the Darkness!
2. Added Main Story - Domain 9 Frost-Covered Marshville. Also added the Marshville Side Missions.
With the help of the Hykros technology, Domain 9 has successfully completed the transformation of the Infinite Sundial, resolving the power crisis and hoping to shift from defense to offense. Wanderers who have come to Marshville will delve deeper into the secrets of the past and the bond between Ling Han, the current Baihu, and Nan Yin, the former Overseer of Yuheng.
3. Added a world boss, Darkness: Xingtian, a story boss, and some new creatures
4. Added a new Simulacrum: Ling Han
Limited Simulacrum, Ling Han, and a limited weapon, Alabaster Tiger, are coming soon.
5. Fresh seasonal gameplay with an increased level cap
The level cap has been increased to 100, with the new Wormhole level and new Frontier Evolution season unlocked.

a) New Equipment Augment Parts: fortress armor and fortress sabatons
b) New Smart Servants: Snowy and Leia
c) The 7th level has been added to Sequential Phantasm Boundless Realm

notes.title: v3.2 Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a resource update and server maintenance to bring you a better gaming experience. v3.2 The Dragon Grove will be available following the update.
You will not be able to enter the game during the maintenance period. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The update plan and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤ Update Time ◢[/h2]
September 5, 04:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)
※Note: After this update, the weekly activity and weekly gameplay will not be reset.

[h2]◤ Update Method ◢[/h2]
● Resource Update: After the server is shut down, you can update the game in advance to play the new version as soon as the server opens. It is recommended to update the game when your device is connected to WiFi. Below are the ways to update the game.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is shut down, please manually exit the client and restart it. Then update the launcher.
2. Please tap Update on the launcher. After the update resources start downloading, you can minimize the window. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
Note: The PC launcher has been upgraded. If a login error occurs after the version update, please restart the launcher, log out of your account, and log back in. If the issue persists, please contact Customer Service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. The game package needs to be changed in this version. After the server is shut down, please download the new app version in your device's application store.
2. After launching the game and starting downloading the update resources, you can let the game run in the background. The update will continue in the background until it is completed.
● Server shutdown: You are recommended to prepare to log out of the game 15 minutes before the update. Please do not make any purchases in the 5 minutes before the server shutdown to avoid game experience and account asset losses.

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
- Compensation Eligibility: Players who reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. Added a Domain 9 map: Joltville.
Explore the majestic mountains and mystical realms, stroll through the bustling bazaar, or immerse yourself in the tranquil greenery of the bamboo groves!
2. Added Main Story - Domain 9, Joltville Clouds. Also added the Joltville Side Missions.
The main reason that led to the timestamp crisis of Domain 9 lies with the Infinite Sundial, a large field energy reactor. The discoveries from the outside world brought hope, revealing a truth that astounds all.
3. Added a world boss, Darkness: Taotie.
4. Added a new Simulacrum, Huang.
The limited Simulacrum, Huang, and the limited weapon, Azure Dragon, are coming soon.
5. Introduced the Frontier Clash seasonal update. Added new enemies and adjusted the difficulty.
6. Added the new Artificial Island Home farming gameplay.
Within the Overworld, there is a great chance to encounter catchable beasts. Wanderers can attempt to catch them through feeding and build a beast pen in Artificial Island Home to raise them.
7. A new limited-time Raid instance, Gluttonous Feast.
Darkness: Taotie in Domain 9 is colossal and harnesses dark energy capable of devouring all. Wanderers need to employ diverse strategies according to Taotie's mechanics and collaborate closely with teammates to eliminate this creature!
※Gluttonous Feast does not share the same cooldown with regular Raids. Please feel free to participate in it.
8. Added the Boundless Realm Mode to Sequential Phantasm.
Added a one-time-only power shot reward for this mode. The power shot permanently increases all attack.
9. Added the Extreme Test to Training Center where you can customize enemies and test it out in combat.
10. Introduced a new Smart Servant, Zongyun.

◆ Participation Conditions:
Complete the main Story, Ecological Station Intruders, and unlock the Rewards page.
◆ Event Introduction:
Participate in “Starchaser Championship”, “Jade Pavilion Path, Bomber Arena”, and ""Stealth Shadows"" during the event to earn jade coins and jade ingots that can be used to redeem items in the Event Store. You can also claim rewards by meeting the requirements of Black Jade Warrior and 7-Day Sign-In.
Event rewards: Jade coins and jade ingots can be used to redeem Ming Jing Haute Couture skin: Zeke and Fading Shadows weapon skin, Nemesis Haute Couture skin: Shirli and White Dwarf weapon skin, Alternate Destiny Relic, avatars, avatar frames, chat bubbles, red nuclei, fortress tactics eyepieces, fortress microreactors, and fortress exoskeletons.

1. Starchaser Championship
[h2]Event Time:[/h2]
8/8/2023, after version update to 9/4/2023, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
The event is a match of 8 people, and each Wanderer needs to pay 800 copper blooms to enter the game.
1. In each match, there are 4 participants assigned to different lanes. The traps on each lane will be randomly refreshed when the match starts.
2. Each participant has three stats: Endurance, Speed, and Physique, each with different effects.
Endurance: The upper limit of a participant's Endurance. When a participant is moving, their Endurance will be consumed every second. When a participant's Endurance is depleted, they will enter the fatigued state, and their speed will be reduced. When a participant is in a fatigued state, their Endurance will be restored every second, and they will continue the race at full speed once their Endurance has been fully restored.
Speed: The running speed of a participant who is not in the fatigued state.
Physique: Participant's Physique. Upon encountering a trap, it determines whether the trap will be triggered.
3. Wanderers can evaluate the trap status and participant stats on each lane, then select their preferred participant. Each participant can be selected by multiple Wanderers at the same time.
4. At the end of the match, rewards will be issued based on the rankings of the participants. Wanderers who have selected the champion will evenly share the copper blooms.

2. Black Jade Warrior
[h2]Event Time:[/h2]
8/8/2023, after version update to 9/4/2023, 21:00 (UTC+0)
◆ Event Introduction:
New Raid instance: Black Jade Warrior. Complete the designated Raid Missions in Cloud Viewing during the event to earn rewards.
1. To claim the rewards for an instance, 1 reward attempt will be deducted.
2. In Heroic Difficulty, each Wanderer has 1 chance to be rescued after receiving grievous injuries.
3. After selecting Assist in the preparation phase, reward attempts will not be deducted for clearing the stage, but no rewards will be issued.
4. Switching weapons and Relics will be prohibited upon entering the boss room until you leave.
5. Invincibility is disabled on challenging difficulty, and non-Benediction Resonance healing is reduced by 80%.
※Difficulty Reduction
The instance difficulty will be greatly reduced after 22 August. It's not possible to obtain a limited title after the difficulty has been reduced.

8/11/2023, 04:00 to 9/4/2023, 21:00 (UTC+0)

Open a box to receive 1 to 2 Old Friend shards, and collect 150 of them to unlock the Old Friend avatar, Full Moon Reunion avatar frame, and Bright Evening Lights chat bubble. Executors can view the mystery giftbox's portal on the map, which will only show up when the boat passes by. All gift boxes will disappear when the boat parade ends.
3. Executors can receive up to 20 mystery giftboxes each day.

notes.title: August 8th Maintenance Over
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderer,

Today's maintenance is over. Thank you for your understanding, patience and support!

[h2]◤ Compensation ◢[/h2]
Server shutdown compensation: 500 dark crystals
Client update compensation: 200 dark crystals
Boundless Realm weak point bug fixing compensation: 200 dark crystal
- Compensation range: Players who reached level 6 before the update
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.

[h2]◤ Update Content ◢[/h2]
◆ New Gameplay
1. New map area: Cloudpeak Manor
Cloudpeak Manor is available in Ignisville. 2 Vermilion Statues and 1 new Tower Slayer are added.
- We will send the above compensation to your Mailbox within 2 hours of the maintenance update completion. Please check your Mailbox.
3. New Simulacrum, Ming Jing, is coming soon with a new Side Mission Story
Lord Xuanwu's blade is capable of cutting through everything. With him around, we can definitely defeat the Darkness. Ming Jing and his Simulacrum Story Mission is coming soon!
4. New Side Mission Story: Jade Pavilion Fair
Attend a date at the Jade Pavilion under the full moon of the summer night. Guests of various origins gather together, reunions and encounters take place here!
5. New Raid: Black Jade Warrior
Black Jade Warrior is a limited-time Raid. Zhuyan's Flames of Wrath are extremely dangerous. Please be very careful!
※Black Jade Warrior does not share the same cooldown with regular Raids. Please feel free to participate in it.
6. Evolved and more challenging Frontier Clash
A new Evolution Mode is added to Frontier Clash. The gameplay is now seasonal, and you will challenge the boss in stages. You will get rewards based on the stage you have completed!
7. New Equipment Augment Parts: fortress bracers and fortress legguards
8. New Combat Servant: Flame Sparrow

[h3]◆ New events (please see the in-game info)[/h3]

notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! To enhance your gaming experience, we will be shutting down our servers for game resource updates and maintenance, and the Ver. 3.0 Domain 9 Sector will become available once the update is finished.
During the maintenance, you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
The details of the update and compensation are as follows:

◤Update Time◢
06:00–09:00 on June 27 (UTC+0) (Depending on maintenance conditions, the server may be back online later or earlier than scheduled)
※ Note: After this update, the "Weekly Activity" of the Wanderer will be reset

◤Update Method◢
● Resource Updates: Considering the large size of the update, we recommend finishing the update procedure once the server is down so you can experience the new version as soon as it is back up. Wi-Fi is recommended for downloading the update. The instructions for updating are provided below.
◆ PC:
1. After the server is down, please exit and restart the game client manually, then update the launcher.
2. Please click Update in the launcher. Once the resource has begun downloading, you can minimize the launcher window. Updates will be carried out in the background until they are complete.
Special Reminder: The PC launcher will be updated this time. If you encounter an error after the update, please log out and restart the launcher before logging in again. If the problem persists, please get in touch with customer service.
◆ Android & iOS:
1. This update requires a new package. Please go to the app store of your mobile device to download the latest version of the app once the server has been taken down.
2. Once you've launched the game and the download has started, you may run it in the background until the update finishes.
● Server-down maintenance: We suggest that you log off 15 minutes before the maintenance begins, and please do not make purchases 5 minutes before the server is down in order to avoid negative gaming experiences and losses of your in-game properties.

◤Compensation◢
Maintenance compensation: <span color="#FF573EFF">300 dark crystals</>
Client update compensation: <span color="#FF573EFF">200 dark crystals</>
Equipment Augment gameplay description ambiguity compensation: <span color="#FF573EFF">10 core control modules + 25 augmentation factors</>
- Compensation eligibility: Reach Wanderer Lv. 6 before the update
- We will deliver the aforementioned compensation to you via mail within 2 hours after the maintenance. Do remember to check your mailbox and claim them.

◤Updates◢
◆ New Gameplay
1. New Main Story, Domain 9: Ignisville Gale, and Ignisville-themed Side Missions
Ignisville is at times of imminent crisis. At the other side of the celestial gate, danger lurks in Domain 9. With the increasing harassment from the Darkness, the energy that is supposed to suppress these enemies is getting depleted. Wanderers will embark on a new adventure to look for new strengths and new partners to face the crisis triggered by the depleting energy altogether.
2. New Map: Domain 9
Opened up Ignisville, which comprises areas such as Ignisville Mansion, Windward Outskirts, Black Jade Ruins, and Cloud Summit. Experience the thrill of new exploration modes and engaging puzzles.
3. New Simulacrum Liu Huo Is Coming Soon
She wields an ink brush to fight off the Darkness. What an amazing way to practice calligraphy in combat! The Domain Guard of Farewellville, Liu Huo, is expecting your arrival! The new weapon: Pine Comet, and Simulacrum: Liu Huo, will soon be available.
4. New Mentorship System
Wanderers can look for mentors or recruit apprentices on the Mentorship screen. Guided growth, shared success. Complete Mentorship Missions with your mentor/apprentice to receive generous rewards.
5. New Smart Servant System
The activated smart servant will assist in the battle when entering the combat state, providing damage and buffs during the battle. Combat strength can be increased by upgrading the smart servant. Wanderers can obtain smart servants and enhancement materials by exploring the Domain 9 map.
6. Wormhole 2.0
The Wormhole has been revamped and loaded with better rewards. The all-new mechanics will definitely take the challenge of Wanderers' flexibility and adaptability to another level!
7. New World Boss
Get ready to take on the new world boss in Domain 9, Zhuyan. The boss is waiting for your challenge at the foot of Spiritfall Rise!
8. Other New Content
a) The level cap is increased to Lv. 95
b) New suppressor level unlocked
c) New SSR Relic: Speedwalkers
d) New dimension level rollback feature
e) New story navigation feature: Now you can choose and directly enter the story chapter of your choice
f) New Domain 9 achievements and titles
g) Added new Bounty Missions for Domain 9 and adjusted Bounty Missions for other regions

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy Version 2.4 Updates
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderers,
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! To enhance your gaming experience, we will be shutting down our servers for game resource updates and maintenance, and the Ver. 2.4 The Grand Sea will become available once the update is finished.
During the maintenance, you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The details of the update and compensation are as follows:

[h2]◤Update Time◢[/h2]
March 30 06:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Depending on maintenance conditions, the server may be back online later or earlier than scheduled)

[h2]◤Update Method◢[/h2]
● Resource Updates: Considering the large size of the update, we recommend finishing the update procedure once the server is down so you can experience the new version as soon as it is back up. Wi-Fi is recommended for downloading the update. The instructions for updating are provided below.
◆ PC: Expected Update Size - 19G
1. After the server is down, please exit and restart the game client manually, then update the launcher.
2. Please click Update in the launcher. Once the resource has begun downloading, you can minimize the launcher window. Updates will be carried out in the background until they are complete.
Special Reminder: The launcher on the Pc will be updated this time. If you encounter an error after the update, please log out and restart the launcher before logging in again. If the problem persists, please get in touch with customer service.
◆ Android : Expected Update Size - 0.91G (App Resource); 14G (after logging in)
◆ iOS: Expected Update Size - 2.49G (App Resource); 11.78G (after logging in)
1. This update requires a new package. Please go to the app store of your mobile device to download the latest version of the app once the server has been taken down.
2. Once the game is activated and started to download, you may run it in the background until the update finishes.
● Server-down maintenance: We suggest that you log off 15 minutes before updating commences, and please do not make purchases 5 minutes before the server is down in order to avoid negative gaming experiences and losses of your in-game properties.

[h2]◤Compensation◢[/h2]
Maintenance compensation:  [b]300 dark crystals [/b]
Client update compensation:  [b]200 Dark Crystals[/b]
Dream Machine Adjustment compensation: spacetime crystal fragments*40
New section in Raid: Spatial Reorganizer I*1 (which can grants another reward chance for Raids)
- Compensation eligibility: [h3]Reach Wanderer Lv. 6 before the update[/h3]
- We will deliver the aforementioned compensation to you via mail within 2 hours after the maintenance. Do remember to check your mailbox and claim them
[h2]◤Updates◢[/h2]
[h2]◆ New Gameplay[/h2]
1. Chapter 10 Main Story
New chapters are unlocked in the main story, in which Wanderers will encounter many new and old friends along the journey to unmask the truth of Abyssants together!
2. New Map: Grand Sea
Wanderers can start their exploration from top to bottom through the upper level of the Grand Sea Island, transiting through Innars, then go all the way to the Dragon Breath Volcano which lies deep underwater. Come and experience a unique underwater ecosystem, many interacting battles, and puzzle-solving gameplay.
3. New Underwater Vehicles
There are 3 underwater vehicles added to the new map: Diamond Wings, Vision Sphere, and Sunfish, which Wanderers can obtain through the Gachapon Machine.
4. Underwater Request Mission
With the new map content, optimized request missions, and upgraded mission rewards, Wanderers can now get themselves a full set of gold equipment in a short period of time by completing the underwater Appointed Research!
5. New World Boss
In the new map, there are two new world bosses, Abyssant: Scylla, who lives in the Grand Sea, and Abyssant: Haboela, in the volcano center. They await Wanderers to challenge.
6. Revamped Sequential Phantasm
First season availability: After the version update till 2023/05/11 05:00 (Server Time)
The stage design of the revised Sequential Phantasm mechanism for the season is much more enjoyable and interesting and topped with even more fantastic rewards. Hurry and challenge yourself with different lineups!
7. New Instance: Ring of Oblivion
The latest Raid instance for the team is added with a special positive/negative current explosion mechanism, enhancing the fun and challenge altogether! Join forces with your teammate and crusade against the big boss Abyssant: Eva, to showcase your skills!
8. Other New Content
a) Added the quick battle feature in Dimensional Trials and Interstellar Exploration
b) Added buffs for Wanderers when they enter the Joint Operation solo or with low power to improve the combat experience
c) Added the bullet module settings when activating Clover Cross for the first time
d) Obtain exclusive outfits or outfit shards by opening the world boss chest (or through the forced decryption)
e) Added two sets of new servers: North America-Oasis, Southeast Asia-Tore de Utopia (available after the update).
f) Unlocked new levels for Suppressor
g) New Mira Gachapon Machines and Old Vera Coin Gachapon Machines in Mirroria City
h) Made it possible for Wanderers to enter other Wanderers' Artificial Island in Building Mode
i) Added New NPC and function: Artificial Island Mysterious Vendorn
j) Added quick equip function to Matrix Set

◆ New Events (refer to the actual online event as final)
We will launch a series of new activity events after the update. For specific event rules, please refer to Ver. 2.4 First Event Preview.
1. Under the Grand Sea Version Guiding Events
During the event, complete a specified number of the version guiding missions to receive rewards such as SSR Relic—Mini Pelican and dark crystals.
a) Deepsea Treasure Hunt
Event Time: After the version update till (UTC+0) 2023/05/10 21:00
b) Challenger's To-do List
Event Time: After the version update till (UTC+0) 2023/05/10 21:00
2. Sailing the Lost Sea
Claim HF Navigators on the event page and track their signals to receive rewards such as the red nucleus.
Event Time: After the version update till (UTC+0) 2023/04/06 21:00
3. Springtime Saunter
Obtain saunter tokens by participating in the event to exchange rewards such as the red nucleus.
a) Water Bomb Impact

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy characters: all Simulacra, traits and skins
notes.notes:
So you want to know about Tower of Fantasy characters? Known in-game as 'Simulacra', these are the new anime game's collectable personae that you can earn. Sometimes they come as quest rewards, but the main unlock method is through interacting with the myriad of progression systems, events, and the 'special order' banners that you'll recognise from similar open-world games like Genshin Impact.

You might also see characters referred to by their signature Tower of Fantasy weapon. Unlike in Genshin Impact, Tower of Fantasy characters are unlocked the moment you obtain their weapon - you won't have to draw for both, and you can't get one without the other. Characters are also separated into SSR and SR tiers - a slightly old-school version of the five and four-star (respectively) system you'll recognise from elsewhere.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Wandering Amidst Miasma Is now in the Tower of Fantasy 2.3!
notes.notes:
[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/3d7dbbb330eff7343e4b26e6100c79b8.jpg[/img]

 

Dear Wanderers,

Version 2.3 of Tower of Fantasy, Wandering Amidst Miasma, becomes officially available on February 2, 2023! Explore the Miasmic Swamp, try out the new Simulacrum, Alyss, and unlock even more new storylines, instances, and modes!

We are grateful to have you along the journey! Tower of Fantasy's Half-Anniversary reward event will be coming with the Version 2.3 update, and there will be even more amazing rewards, such as dark crystals and free vehicles for you!

Below, we will go over the new content in version 2.3 and Half-Anniversary.

 
[list][*]New Map, New Story 
[/*][*]New Simulacrum: Alyss 
[/*][*]New Instance 
[/*][*]New limited-time events 
[/*][/list]
 

 

 

 
[h1][b]New Map, New Story[/b][/h1]
 
[h3]Miasmic Swamp area becomes available.[/h3]
A new map, Miasmic Swamp, becomes available. Vera's ecosystem is taken to a whole new level by the map's unique landform filled with rock pillars and rainforest vegetation found in the Miasmic area.

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/affa98f25eb438483a1b80eea699bc7c.png[/img]

 
[h3]Rich and diverse exploration and puzzle-solving mechanism to set off a new adventure.[/h3]
 

[b]I. Interacting in many scenes with diverse settings and trying out interesting puzzle-solving gameplay.[/b]

Further enriches the exploration experience by allowing Wanderers to interact with Colorful Mushrooms.

 

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/7d1ad87117393eaf9037c176df405387.png[/img][img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/27f7c9f564d36564e182c26a649fdff9.gif[/img]

[u]There are Colorful Mushrooms in many different colors all over the rainforest. Try to interact with them to solve the puzzle![/u]

 

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/7f439ecd57ffc58e8d91755e35172198.png[/img]

[u]There are special triggers scattered on the ground. Activate their core and obtain rewards by stepping on the baseplate correctly. Trigger conditions vary for different colors.[/u]

 

[b]II. All-new adventure experience. Unmask the secret in the mist![/b]

This mysterious swamp is shrouded by heavy mist. Let's search for the secret hiding in the mist together!

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/ed86a0f6a7c14ff2fa32d604f7ab6377.png[/img]

 

The swamp mist came from Titan Konjac, which continues releasing poison gas to prevent travelers from getting close to it. But to the surrounding area of Titan Konjac, you can find an item called Revelation Seed, which is the starting point of purifying the mist.

To be able to obtain the Revelation Seed with ease, Wanderers need to activate the Purification System first to temporarily neutralize the poisons of Titan Konjac. After gathering the Revelation Seed, Wanderers can now activate "Brood" to summon creatures and defeat them to obtain Germinated Revelation Seed. By then, it can be used to shut down Titan Konjac and purify the poison mist in the forest.

 

[u][b][Purification System][/b][/u]

A machine that houses Revelation Seeds. Once activated, it sprays an atomized mist of diluted Revelation Tree Sap in every direction,which neutralizes the poison of Titan Konjac within the effective duration. Make sure you activate it before stepping into the mist!

[u][b][img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/c8fa0b5c5e2363fcf2afde57a92abb38.png[/img][/b][/u]

 

 

[u][b][Revelation Seed][/b][/u]

Revelation Seeds grow within the poison gas of Titan Konjac. Wanderers need to gather them to trigger the creature inside the Brood.

[u][b][img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/c9506c6eb8628f1f92a13685eb8c6f8c.png[/img][/b][/u]

 

 

[u][b][Brood][/b][/u]

Found in the swamp, it's a special, egg-like structure which can be activated by using revelation seeds and different kinds of elemental ores. With the right combination of catalysts, powerful creatures can be hatched from these structures.

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/c2734e73c019ad8acf021479ec2f0813.png[/img]

 

 

[u][b][Germinated Revelation Seed][/b][/u]

After defeating the elite enemies, Wanderers can obtain the Germinated Revelation Seed to shut down Titan Konjac.

 

 

 
[h3]Ch.9 Main Story Available[/h3]
Travel through the swamp in the new story mission and explore the secrets hidden within the miasma!

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/f6857c17cf584e15146d788bc3d84d51.png[/img]

 

 

 

 

 
[h1]New Simulacrum: Alyss[/h1]
 

 

[b]Elegant dancer on the ice—The new Simulacrum Alyss is available soon![/b]

The limited frost weapon, Unyielding Wing and Alyss Matrix are open.

For detailed character guides, please watch the video below.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/BmXPvs5v20g?rel=0&loop=0&autoplay=0&playsinline=1

 

[b]Alyss Simulacrum Mission[/b]

She used to be the light in Mirroria—until she woke up from the nightmare. Her wings become young and immature once again.

A "recruit" of Mirroria Security Force. She once suffered from unexplainable headaches... What kind of past is this young recruit hiding? Let's find out together!

Accept Alyss's Simulacrum Mission on the Simulacra page to experience Alyss's story.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/0ifC7b3qHiY?rel=0&loop=0&autoplay=0&playsinline=1

 

 

 

 

 
[h1]New Instance[/h1]
 
[h3]New Team Instance: Origin of War[/h3]
Origin of War is a new tower mode that requires a team of 4. There is a total of 25 levels, and each level has its own stage affix.

First season period: 2023/2/2 5:00 ~ 2023/4/1 23:59 (Server Time) 

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/f7fe3eca838e3b9b72684b8e1ccd8f32.png[/img]

Wanderers need to depend on each other's wisdom and strength to challenge the enemies on each level, setting up different plans based on the stage affix to tackle each level. A certain amount of rewards can be obtained after clearing each level, and there is a chance of obtaining buffs to help out the Wanderers in the stage that follows.

For the detailed gameplay guide, please tap -> [u][url=https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/news-detail.html?content_id=7f1bb355ae4cea4f5fa8b0fa7b9f099d0b08]Origin of War Guide Link[/url][/u].

 
[h3]New Joint Operation Instance: Carnival Party[/h3]
Engage in various battles with The Noise Band and finish the thrilling rhythm challenge. Defeat the musicians at the end to be rewarded with chests and golden quality equipment.

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/c8493f79d4b286f52c593c4f4ba61a17.png[/img]

 

 
[h3]New Joint Operation Instance: Pursuit of Fate[/h3]
A gameplay that combines battles and driving together. It got the best of both worlds; engage in thrilling battles while experiencing the fun of driving! Activate the mechanism and defeat the final boss to receive golden quality equipment.

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/dff6f6fe448857f58f96b22ac9714c82.png[/img]

 

 
[h3]Bygone Phantasm: Boundless Realm[/h3]
Reach Bygone Phantasm floor 500 to unlock the newly-released high-difficulty levels.  Challenge the bosses to rise higher and earn golden quality equipment and items.

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/7bee2a49f71cf5d047f124cdadb98810.png[/img]

 

 
[h3]Other New Content:[/h3]
◆  New equipment slot: Exoskeleton

◆  Increased the level cap gradually to Lv. 90

 

 

 

 

 
[h1]New limited-time events[/h1]
 

 

New limited-time events are here! Let's celebrate the Tower of Fantasy Half-Anniversary altogether!

 
[h3]Passion for Chocolate[/h3]
◆ Event Time: (UTC+0) 2023/2/2(after maintenance) – 2023/2/17 21:00

 

Collect ingredients and make chocolates as gifts for characters to obtain ardor. Accumulate the specified amount of ardor to claim red nuclei, gold nuclei, titles, avatar frames, and other rewards.

Each character has a different preference; make sure you pick their favorite chocolate!

 

[b]Key rewards:[/b]

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/c97a2d889762eb32663822b4f4023410.png[/img]

 

 
[h3]Half-Anniversary Party[/h3]
 

[b]Frost and Flame[/b]

◆ Event Time: (UTC+0) 2023/2/9–2023/3/8

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/f20f3966fa72a3ef386e62385c38ac6b.png[/img]

Frost and Flame is a multi-player battle where the same number of enemies will be spawned on both the Flame and Frost side, attacking your Core Crystal.

Wanderers split up into two teams, flame and frost, to defeat the enemies coming through the portal and to protect their own Core Crystal from being destroyed.

Wanderers can obtain buffs by defeating enemies, but make sure you pick up the one that fits the stat of your team. You can ask for help from your teammate if you get knocked down! 

 

[b]Fruit Barrage[/b]

◆ Event Time: (UTC+0) 2023/2/16–2023/3/8

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/5e81e7feab4b021e6a108351c0c5ad67.png[/img]

Wanderers on the wooden bridge need to dodge the fruits by jumping and crouching. Watermelons can be dodged by crouching, and pineapples can be dodged by jumping.

 

You will be knocked back upon getting hit. If you are hit 3 times, you will end up in the water. The travel speed of the fruits becomes faster and faster, and the Wanderer who survives the longest time will be the winner.

 

Pay attention to the timing of crouching and jumping. Acting too early or too late will result in getting hit.

 

[b]Heavy Punch[/b]

◆ Event Time: (UTC+0) 2023/2/23–2023/3/8

[img]https://d34ss71p31mwba.cloudfront.net/cms/nrft/feeds/pic/070376d647e1754c999a5ac08fc3a25d.png[/img]

The Heavyweight Boxing consists of the Hider faction and Controller faction. Wanderers will get assigned to one of the factions at random and receive a random appearance. One of the participating Wanderers controls Sweetie and its punching to initiate attacks. There are multiple Hiders who need to keep moving around quickly. Pay attention to the tips from the surrounding light bars and dodge the attacks by moving around.

 

[b]Participate to receive:[/b]

notes.title: Void Abyss Guide
notes.notes:
Greetings Wanderes! The advanced mode of Void Rift, the Void Abyss instance, will be coming in Ver. 2.2! Based on the existing combat challenges of Void Rift, Void Abyss brings a new level of difficulty and introduces the Tech gameplay in a combination of RNG and strategy. Let's take a look at this new mode!
 
[h3][b]Void Abyss[/b][/h3]
How to Access: Reach Lv. 80 and clear Void Rift
Start Time: From January 1, progress resets monthly on the 1st
Rewards: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/1b804042eadda619525d04d8cea90343ed266913.png[/img]

[h3][b]Void Abyss Overall Guide[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Entry[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/e4ff78a1e83ea530de2036e9f02805920c870dd8.png[/img]

Enter via Adventure → Challenge → Void Rifts → Abyssal.
 
[h3][b]New System: Abyssal Tech[/b][/h3]
Abyssal Tech is a passive buff system that provides buffs in exchange for special resources. Exchanges must be completed before entering the Void Abyss and buffs can be retained. In every monthly cycle, you'll gradually accumulate more special resources as your number of challenges increases. Exchange these special resources for even more tech and upgrade them to gain a greater advantage in the Abyss.
Do keep in mind that Abyssal Tech is divided into three main branches. Combine your own weapon configuration with the right Abyssal Tech to truly excel in the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/4855cba68c711287407ee5427e6d475931c23655.png[/img]

[h3][b]Tech Exchange[/b][/h3]
You can exchange the special resources, void energy, for tech. According to the event cycle, tech and void energy will be reset on a monthly basis.
 
[h3][b]Loading Tech[/b][/h3]
The first step in exchanging void energy for tech is to load up the tech of your selected branch. Tap on the "Load" button. The system will randomly generate tech for you to choose from.
Please note that selecting a certain branch of tech will increase the probability of it being generated, but tech from other branches may still be generated.
 
[h3][b]Redrawing[/b][/h3]
If none of the generated tech strikes your fancy, you can opt to spend a small amount of void energy for a redraw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/389415a2647f0c0b49367511d2c8a585dff51725.png[/img]

[h3] 
[b]Cost Accrual[/b][/h3]
After loading a certain branch of tech, the cost of loading that tech will increase exponentially with its load count. Please do keep an eye on the cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/2fc10a7d03f17e56d78b918e919be79ef63d1331.png[/img]

[h3][b]Upgrading Tech[/b][/h3]
Your tech will automatically upgrade to an advanced tech once you obtain 3 tech of the same kind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/1a6b1e849c05b1ab4fe83befdc85c7c4b38304fa.png[/img]
 
Only 1 of the same type of tech will remain active, and priority is given to the tech at a higher level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/1c348f09011f698273c65bfb25136af64b7d7ed7.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]Recycling Tech[/b][/h3]
Tech can be recycled to regain a portion of void energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/e622c745f2278f5fa5910ada248446eda1f72dea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Obtaining Void Energy[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Method 1: [/b][/h3]Clear the Void Rift. Clearing the week's Void Rift before challenging the Void Abyss is recommended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/31b6d62427174eb51259c6e93faf803c9a100ac4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Method 2:[/b][/h3] Purchase it with gold. If you're planning on getting some tech with high stats, then consider purchasing void energy with gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/a3f11efff8515b772df1ba5104b5e505c83e184e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Classes[/b][/h3]
The Void Abyss is a hard stage, so it's recommended that a clear division of roles is established between team members to increase efficiency when using Abyssal Tech. Now, let's take a look at the responsibilities and buff effects of each class.
 
[h3][b]Attack: Provide High DPS[/b][/h3]
Tech effects provide buffs to various types of damage, which can increase crit rate and even trigger Finisher effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/de162207bbd19d53a8399bd5d25edab86b6f107b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Recommended Tech:[/b][/h3]
Heart of Thorns: Can be stacked for a high damage boost
All attack types +3,800/7,000. Gain a 2.5%/4% damage boost for every enemy defeated. Stacks up to 15 times.
Overclocking Program: Trades fault tolerance for a high damage boost
All attack types +3,800/7,000. Damage taken +20%, damage dealt +40%/60%.
Obliterator: Unleashes a Finisher that greatly improves DPS
All attack types +3,800/7,000. If target HP is below 12%/20%, attack has a 10% chance of finishing the target.
 
[h3][b]Defense: Draw Boss's Aggro, Tank Boss Attacks, and Wield Rapid Shield Shattering[/b][/h3]
Tech effects provide various types of resistance and increase HP as well as shield. Some even offer the escape death effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/5eb0100271b0f7001c6e1d74b14cf8ad3565e7c6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Recommended Tech:[/b][/h3]
Breakpoint Slash: Rapid shield break. Improves shatter
Health +18%/30%. Shield break effectiveness is increased by 200%/350%.
Numerology: Escapes death and increases fault tolerance
Health +18%/30%. When HP reaches 0, instantly recover 50% HP. Cooldown: 2.5/1.5 minutes.
Void Armor: Provides a lasting shield and an improvement to endurance
Health +18%/30%. Every 25 seconds, generate a shield equal to 30%/50% of Max HP for 10 seconds.
 
[h3][b]Support: Provide Recovery and Damage Boosts for Teammates while Inflicting Debuffs on the Boss[/b][/h3]
Tech effects provide a further increase to healing capability and buff for teammates to increase their DPS while debuffing the boss, consequently increasing your teammates' survivability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/2de59999bdb11dd1c66c2096979a4cd832c03fde.png[/img]

[h3][b]Recommended Tech:[/b][/h3]
Assault Resonance: Provides a damage boost to teammates
Healing +20%/35%. Halo: Damage dealt by allies +25%/45%.
Lifeshield: Provides shields to teammates and improves endurance
Healing +20%/35%. When healing, provide the target with a shield equal to 15%/25% of Max HP for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
[b]In addition, if your team's weapon star rating is relatively low, you can select the Knack for Advancement tech. Its Rank II provides an increase of +4 star rating for all weapons![/b]
 
[h3][b]Boss Stats[/b][/h3]
Similar to Void Rift, the boss challenge will be unlocked once 3 keys have been collected. The boss of each stage comes with its own stats, traits, and weak points. The right configuration of weapons and buffs that focuses on the boss's stats will make the battle much easier for you.
Example: Barbarossa is a physical boss that receives increased flame and frost damage. Select the right stats to conquer it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/e592cb7e42f12f9c84b5f606a5c71ffb1e746db9.png[/img]

[h3][b]Appendix: Tech Overview[/b][/h3]
We have listed out the tech which will be available during this month's Void Abyss to help you draw and organize your lineup better.
(The values before and after "/" respectively represent the stats of Rank I and Rank II)

[table]
[tr]
    [th]Type[/th]
    [th]Tech[/th]
    [th]Stats[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Defense[/td]

notes.title: Version 2.2 Updates
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderers,

Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! To enhance your gaming experience, we will be shutting down our servers for maintenance, during which you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The details of the update and compensation are as follows:

[b]◤Update Time ◢ [/b]
December 22 05:00–10:00(UTC+0) (Depending on maintenance conditions, the server may be back online later or earlier than scheduled)

[b]◤Update Method◢ [/b]
Server-down maintenance: We suggest that you log off 15min before updating commences and stop all top up activities 5 mins before in order to avoid negative gaming experience and losses of your in-game properties.
PC & Mobile: Restart the client after exiting the game to automatically apply the updates

[b]◤Compensation◢ [/b]
Maintenance compensation: 500 dark crystals & radar detector*2
Client update compensation: 200 Dark Crystal
Compensation eligibility:  Reach Wanderer Lv. 6 before the update
We will deliver the aforementioned compensation to you via mail within 2 hours after the maintenance. Do remember to check your mailbox and claim them

[b]◤Updates◢[/b]
[b]◆ New Content[/b]
1.	Mirroria District B/C Unlocked
a)	Places like the Mirramoon Street, Treasured Garden, Aquaria Palace, Coolyland, Entertainment Center, Tower of Tomorrow, Star Apartments, Mirafleur Hall Guest Room, Oasis Club, etc. are available
b)	A large number of interior scenes and interactive content are now open. Wanderers can experience various everyday interactions such as settlement, amusement, racing, and audio-visual entertainment in Mirroria
c)	New spacerift IN Mirroria: Entertainment Center Balcony/Mirramoon Street
2.	 New gameplay: Void Abyss (Unlocks on local server time 09:00 on January 1st, 2023 and when the Wanderer reaches Lv. 80 and after clearing Void Rift)
3.	New team PvP gameplay: The Critical Abyss (Unlocks when the Wanderer reaches Lv. 80, and opens every day from 12:00–24:00)
4.	New life entertaining gameplay: Fishing, Arcade Minigames, Fight the Landlord, Mahjong, Pet Feeding
5.	Other New Content:
a)	New equipment: Microreactor
b)	New storyline for the research missions

[b]◆ New Events:[/b]
We will launch a series of new events and activities after the update on the 22nd. For specific event rules, please refer to Ver. 2.2 First Event Preview
1.	Supply Run - Christmas-themed sign-in: Available after the server is back online
2.	Winter Festival series events: Available from (UTC+8) 2022/12/24 11:00
3.	Yesterday Once More limited-time side missions: Available from(UTC+8) 2022/12/24 11:00
4.	ToF Referral Program: Available after the server is back online
5.	Tian Lang Limited Cache: Available after the server is back online
6.	Lyra Limited Cache: Available after the server is back online
7.	Claudia Limited Cache: Available from (UTC+8) 2022/12/26 11:00
8. A brand new set of 2.2 version gift packs will be available after the update and on the 24th, please see in-game for more details 

[b]◆ New Feature:[/b]
In order to bring you a better game experience, we will launch the server transfer feature, which is planned to be available in two batches according to the following time. For details, please refer to the follow-up server transfer instructions announcement:
    a) The first batch will be opened on December 29, 2022;
    b) The second batch will open on January 10, 2023.

[b]◆ Optimizations and Bug Fixes:[/b]
1.	Optimized instance difficulty (Spacetime Domain, Interstellar Exploration, Dimensional Trials)
2.	Optimized the world boss combat experience
3.	Optimized server lags
4.	Optimized the issue where players could not enter the game after the game loading progress reached 90%
5.	Fixed an issue where refreshing a web page on the PC may lead to crashes
6.	Fixed the memory leaks found on some mobile devices
7.	Optimized Thai fonts and fixed the problem of overlapping superscripts of some fonts
8.	Fixed the text-overflow issue on the screens of Settings, Weapons, Simulacra, Mounts, and Relics
9.	Fixed the missing translation of some mission dialogues in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and Thai
10.	Supplemented the missing English, Japanese, and Portuguese dubbing of mission dialogues
11.	Optimized the translation of some mission dialogues
12.	Optimized abnormal codes revealed by text formatting changes
13. Updated the Special Order page

Sincerely,
Tower of Fantasy Team

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy Steam version Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Wanderers!
Tower of Fantasy will be available on Steam from October 20. We welcome both new and existing Wanderers to enter Vera Sector via Steam and start a magical adventure in the desert and Mirroria. We have prepared a Steam version adventure guide just for you!

[u][b]Frequently Asked Questions (Key Information)[/b][/u]
[b]Is there a difference between the Steam version and the official version?[/b]
No. All content, including modes, operation events, and purchases, are the same and updated synchronously.

[b]Are the Steam version and official version synched?[/b]
Character information is fully synced between platforms. Your characters, progress, resources, and purchases on iOS, Android, PC: Official, and PC: Steam will be shared between all platforms.
Cross-platform is also enabled, allowing you to play with Wanderers on other platforms.

[b]Can my existing progress and characters in the official version be accessed on Steam?[/b]
Of course. There are two ways to access your progress on Steam:
1.	Directly log in to Steam version with your original account. Steam version will support customized email accounts login and third-party accounts login (we recommend using your original account first if you have one).
2.	You can bind your official account with your Steam account to sync your characters over multiple accounts. [b]Please note that account binding requires specific steps. In order to prevent losses that may arise from errors in the binding process, please make sure to read "How to bind a Steam account" included in this FAQ.[/b]

[u][b]Frequently Asked Questions (Downloading/Installation/Updates)[/b][/u]
[b]How do I download Tower of Fantasy from Steam Store?[/b]
Just like any other Steam game that you've played, you can search for Tower of Fantasy in Steam Store and download it for free from its store page.
If you've received an Ad or email, you can click on the link provided to be redirected to Steam Store page and download the game.

[b]Why can't I download Tower of Fantasy from Steam Store, or do I receive a prompt that Tower of Fantasy is unavailable in my region?[/b]
We regret to inform you that we may be unable to provide our services on Steam in your country or region at this time due to local regulations or platform policies. Due to the varying policies adopted by each platform, you can try using other platforms (e.g., the official PC version) to play the game.

[b]I have the launcher and client from the official version. Do I have to re-download the game? [/b]
Yes. The launcher and client for the official and Steam versions are not interoperable. Even if you have the Official version, you must download the launcher and client via Steam Store to access the Steam version.

[b]Is there a difference between the launchers of the Steam version and the official version?[/b]
The launcher is required for account registration, logging in, and launching the client. In addition, you can view the latest news and announcements in the launcher. But unlike the official version, you will be downloading, updating, and repairing Tower of Fantasy via Steam Store.


[u][b]Frequently Asked Questions (Registration & Logging In & Account Binding)[/b][/u]
[b]What are the avenues available for logging in via Steam version?[/b]
The Steam version allows logging in via email, Steam account, Apple ID, Google, Facebook, Twitter, and Line.
When not using a Steam account to log in, the overall login process is similar to the Official version. Follow the steps to complete email or third-party account verification and login.
When using a Steam account to log in, your current Steam account will be used to log in immediately. [b]Please note that if you haven't bound your existing account to your Steam account, registration will be completed automatically upon logging in for the first time. You will be unable to bind your existing account to your Steam account once that happens. If you need to bind an existing account, please complete the binding process before logging in.[/b]

[b]How to bind a Steam account?[/b]
1.	Log in to the launcher (Official version or Steam version), then click on Account Center in the top right corner.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/706c87c58fec7c50c35ba6552e51ff36b4032af4.png[/img]
2.	Select the Bind Account tab, then click on the Bind button to the right of Steam.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/afa75df9ec8c263c42aef4be89bc847fe68a5f7a.png[/img]
3.	Complete the Steam verification process and bind the account.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/bb238c0a7de3580aec8f6fc1b4ddc4812feca783.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/753a25dd3db8c25768d2ac2be27ceba75614d6b7.png[/img]

[b]Can I log in to the same account through different login avenues?[/b]
Yes, a single account supports logging in through multiple avenues. You can bind your account with all seven login methods in the PC version.


[u][b]Frequently Asked Questions (Gameplay & Payment)[/b][/u]
[b]What are the supported game languages and voice-over languages?[/b]
The current version supports English, Japanese, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai. Voice-over is only supported in English and Japanese. You can switch freely between supported game languages and voice-over languages in the in-game interface Settings - Language.

[b]Will my Steam friend list be synched with my in-game friend list?[/b]
We regret to inform you that Steam friend lists are not supported for now. You can still add friends and play together in-game.

[b]Are Steam achievements and trading cards supported?[/b]
We regret to inform you that Steam achievements and trading cards are not supported for now. We will complete the development of these features as soon as possible.

[b]How do I make payments in the Steam version. Is the Official version's MidasPay supported?[/b]
Regardless of which login avenue you use, Steam Wallet is the only payment processor supported by the Steam Client (however, since account data is synched, purchases made in the Official version will be accessible in the Steam version).
The payment process is as follows:
1.	Select an item in-game and click on the icon to open the Steam payment page.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/d075d76adea19c385ee4b08ac031a79dbd59f96a.png[/img]
2.	Verify the information displayed is accurate. ([b]Please note that due to real-time exchange rate fluctuations and currency support issues, the currency and price displayed in your bill may differ from the currency and price displayed in-game. Please refer to the bill for the accurate currency and pricing.[/b])
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/d72642612dac0dabf90f7f3f2a1750001b4c298a.png[/img]
3.	When your Steam Wallet balance is sufficient, click on [Add Funds] to deduct the corresponding amount and complete the purchase. Once completed, you can return to the game and check if your purchase has been credited to your account.
4.	When your Steam Wallet balance is insufficient, click on [Add Funds] to select your preferred payment method to add funds to your Steam Wallet and complete the purchase.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/96b7728d4883060f915fa7120bcb07bff0247998.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/1c833cf77a65bbeabf4aff616adbbad68e980273.png[/img]
You can also opt to make purchases for your account via other platforms, including iOS: App Store, Google Play: Google Wallet, PC Official: Midas Pay, Official Website: MidasBuy ([url=https://www.midasbuy.com/tof/toweroffantasy-global]https://www.midasbuy.com/tof/toweroffantasy-global[/url]).

[b]I have encountered an issue. How do I contact you?[/b]
You can contact us directly via Steam's Community Discussions and Customer Service. Our Official Communication Channels are also open to Steam users.
1.	Customer Service Email: support@toweroffantasy-global.com
2.	Customer Service: In-game via Settings - Customer Service. You can also contact our customer service personnel via the Customer Service Feedback option at the top right corner of the PC launcher.

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy tier list best weapons and simulacra
notes.notes:
Before we get started with this Tower of Fantasy tier list, it's important to clarify how the roster works exactly. Otherwise known as simulacra, Tower of Fantasy characters are largely cosmetic skins in this anime game. While it's possible to imbue these avatars with minor buffs via the awakening system, most of their skills and abilities are tied to the weapon they wield. Team composition in Tower of Fantasy is closer to a weapons loadout, and the best characters are actually the best Tower of Fantasy weapons.

However, for the purposes of this Tower of Fantasy tier list, we'll primarily be referring to the weapons you pull by the name of the simulacra that comes with them. This tier list also takes into account weapon advancements, which is what happens when you collect a duplicate of an SR or SSR simulacra. Some characters require weapon advancements to fully unlock their potential, while others don't. Without further ado, here is our Tower of Fantasy tier list.

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy is a messy Genshin Impact with few ideas of its own
notes.notes: The most charitable way I could describe Tower of Fantasy's relationship to Genshin Impact would be "inspired." It's so deeply inspired by Hoyoverse's anime character action game that it would be easy to shrug it off as one of the many mobile clones you see show up in ads trying to convince you they're where the real players are at. Its uncanny resemblance to Genshin is the hardest thing to get over in its opening hours, kind of like trying to get over how much Genshin felt like Breath of the Wild when it came out. But if you can grimace through it and restrain your cynicism, the MMO-like systems it introduces could be what sets it apart... Read more.
